The Lurking Storm.name: The Lurking Storm
The Lurking Storm.description: In every puddle near you, in every breeze of wind, the crackle of lightning lingers. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the air, cold, electricity, or water traits that has no duration and deals either physical damage or electricity damage, you choose to deal half of the damage as bludgeoning damage and half the damage as electricity damage.

Explosive Crescendo.name: Explosive Crescendo
Explosive Crescendo.description:
Trigger A creature within range takes sonic damage.

You cause an explosion of music as an erupting climactic finish. The target must attempt a Fortitude save.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}.

Vital Pululation.name: Vital Pululation
Vital Pululation.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

Your life force explodes outward from you. You cast a 3-action @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfZpqmj0AIIdkVIs]{Heal} of a rank equal to the second highest rank spell you can cast without expending a spell slot. You are excluded from the effects of this heal.

Appear Dead.name: Appear Dead
Appear Dead.description: Life drains from your face and your heart slows to nothing as you stop looking like a living creature. For 1 minute, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to appear as a corpse, and you appear dead to senses like lifesense. Mindless undead treat you as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} for the duration of the effect unless they Seek to detect you.

Cease to Be.name: Cease to Be
Cease to Be.description:
Domain nothingness (apocryphal)

You are briefly erased from existence completely. You become invisible and incorporeal, though you cannot pass through solid surfaces. Allied creatures do not treat you as allied for the duration and enemy creatures must succeed at a Recall Knowledge check against your spell DC to identify you as an enemy. You cannot Cast a Spell or target creatures with hostile actions while under the effects of cease to be.

Automummification.name: Automummification
Automummification.description:
Domain vigil (apocryphal)

You dehydrate and preserve yourself perfectly, so that you can guard over the lost for centuries to come. You become a mummy, gaining the basic undead benefits. While the spell is active, if you have not used an action with the auditory, manipulate, or move traits, you automatically extend the duration of the spell at the end of this duration by 10 minutes and continue to do so each time the spell’s duration would normally elapse. You have a +4 circumstance bonus to your Deception DC while in this form if a creature has not seen you move since you Cast the Spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.qdp6T1X5GyRp7raX]{Effect: Automummification}

Enlightened Reliquarian Dedication.name: Enlightened Reliquarian Dedication
Enlightened Reliquarian Dedication.description: You are an enlightened reliquarian, an oracle who reveals your mystery to others. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Js9vTrVqDJQeZ2uP]{Reveal the Mystery} free action.

Vision of the All-Devouring End.name: Vision of the All-Devouring End
Vision of the All-Devouring End.description:
Your vision showed you possible futures of unspeakable horrors, terrible changes to our world and massive loss of life. It is only through you that this end can be stopped. A flame oracle might see a massive draconic figure burning the world to ash, but a gloom oracle might see a never-ending night infested by the undead.

Alternate Domain nightmares

Alternate Granted Spell 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.4koZzrnMXhhosn0D]{Fear}

Granted Skill Intimidation

Vision State You must embrace the fear. You gain a status bonus to Intimidation checks equal to half your cursebound value (minimum 1). After the first turn in an encounter, if you end a turn without giving at least 1 creature the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition or using a cursebound action that turn, you increase your cursebound value by 1 up to your maximum cursebound value.

Awakened State You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} creatures that are temporarily immune to your Demoralize. If your cursebound value is 3, you can Demoralize as a free action with the flourish trait. If your cursebound value is 4, you can cast 3rd rank fear as an innate spell at will.

Past Lives.name: Past Lives
Past Lives.description:
Through intense study of your mystery, you have unlocked memories of your past lives. Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes to gain the effects of a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.hp6Q64dl7xbdn4gQ]{Collective Memories} ritual by calling upon a past life—a mortal from a long time ago, whose soul spent time as a shade in the afterlife before fading into quintessence and becoming the building blocks for your soul. Typically, the youngest a creature like this can be is 1,000 years old, but the creature may have learned information on topics newer than this by conversing with other shades and souls. You retain this past life's appearance for 1 day with the effects of a10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2qGqa33E4GPUCbMV]{Humanoid Form} spell with you emulating the appearance of your past life and you become legendary in one skill appropriate for your past life for the duration.

Additionally, if you remain dead for 1 year, you are automatically reincarnated as through a critical success with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gIVaSCrLhhBzGHQY]{Reincarnate} ritual. Your new face may have a different personality or name, but shares all your memories and most of your ideals.

Dream Come True.name: Dream Come True
Dream Come True.description:
You dive into the mind of a creature, making it appear as if one of its fantasies has come true, or perhaps one of its nightmares. Choose either fantasy or nightmare when you Cast the Spell and the target must attempt a Will save as you create figments from one of its dreams.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your next turn. If you chose a fantasy, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for as long as it is off-guard. If you chose a nightmare, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} in addition to being off-guard and it cannot reduce its frightened condition below 1 while off-guard from this effect. The target can attempt to disbelieve the effect with a single action with the concentrate trait.

Failure As success, except the duration of the off-guard condition is 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the frightened and stupefied values increase to 2. If you chose fantasy, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by the effect and the fascinated condition does not end until the target disbelieves the illusion. If you chose nightmare, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for as long as it is frightened.

Halt Steps.name: Halt Steps
Halt Steps.description:
Trigger A creature moves within 10 feet of you.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater.

Even your exhales are enough to halt an enemy when your curse is at its most chilling. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:spell] save against your spell DC.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed until the end of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.lt6p04NLLhCEj13r]{Effect: Halt Steps}

Failure The creature halts its movement and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round or until it Escapes against your spell DC.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} instead of immobilized.

Hide From Doom.name: Hide From Doom
Hide From Doom.description:
Trigger You would take damage.

You see disaster before it strikes, and weave the strings of fate to keep you from harm. You gain resistance to all damage against the triggering damage equal to [[/r 3 * @item.level + 2 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value]]. If the damage was the result of a critical hit or a critical failure on a basic save, the resistance is doubled.

Heightened (+1) Increase the resistance by 3.

Prophecy.name: Prophecy
Prophecy.description:
You have the gift of foresight, seeing glimpses of futures yet to pass. However, prophecy has become uncertain since the death of Aroden a century ago, and certainly your own divinations do not come to pass. You've also come to terms with a grave truth; there are far more doomed futures than safe ones, and you are plagued by visions of disaster. You may be blessed by gods such as Pharasma, Magdh, or simply born under a chosen star.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.lmHmKGs1N3yNAvln]{Wash Your Luck}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.6ZIKB0151LUR19Rw]{Ill Omen}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.rfFZKfeCSweFv7P3]{Impending Doom}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8THDHP0UC7SgOYYF]{Inevitable Disaster}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.2k0tHIzzZGq3Wub4]{Hide From Doom}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.TGvay9scp7R51wrS]{Assume Destiny}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.NmmMauepJ21ToqlW]{The End is Nigh}

Related Domains disorientation, fate, time, vigil

Mystery Skill Occultism

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.oEpn9Xj6vcCqdCtG]{Glimpse Future}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.Xyt2MJEPNkCbzpBW]{Curse of Countless Fates}

Frigid Journey.name: Frigid Journey
Frigid Journey.description: Your steps cause ice to spread out around you, freezing and preserving the fleeting world and hastening your journey through it. You Stride up to your Speed in a straight line in any direction and across any surface, but if you choose to move up, you must do so at a 45-degree angle. This creates a thin layer of ice in the spaces you pass through which forms a solid structure until the beginning of your next turn. You and creatures can attempt to move along the ice, which is uneven ground, as if it were a solid surface for as long as it remains in effect. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Frigid Journey, the ice lasts until the end of your next turn and if you are cursebound 3, you can Stride up to twice your Speed.

The Bell Tolls Three Times.name: The Bell Tolls Three Times
The Bell Tolls Three Times.description:
Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points or be killed.

You deny the tolling of your death as the divine powers that fuel your mystery flare. You avoid being knocked out and remain at 1 Hit Point. If the trigger was from a death effect, your wounded condition increases by 1.

Arrange the Board.name: Arrange the Board
Arrange the Board.description: You see the sequence of events unfold before your eyes, and you alter it slightly to influence the outcome of the battle. Choose [[/r 2+ @actor.conditions.cursebound.value * 2]] creatures within 30 feet of you. These creatures must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC. Creatures that fail their save immediately Step in a direction of your choice. Allies can choose to get a failure on their result.

Forefathers' Lessons.name: Forefathers' Lessons
Forefathers' Lessons.description:
You evoke the traits of ancestors whose lives were especially different to yours. When you gain this feat, choose a common heritage of your ancestry or another heritage to which you have access. If your heritage allows a selection, you must make these selections when you gain this feat. For 1 minute, you are treated as having that heritage in addition to your heritage.

Special You can take this feat an additional time if you’re at least 12th level and again if you’re at least 18th level, gaining another heritage you could choose to assume when you use Forefather’s Lesson. You can choose between any heritages you have access to when you use this action.

Enlightening Spell.name: Enlightening Spell
Enlightening Spell.description:
You are able to enlighten creatures in the process of applying your magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from one of your oracle spell slots that targets an ally, they can Recall Knowledge as a free action after receiving the effects of the spell. If you are cursebound, they gain a circumstance bonus to their check equal to your cursebound value.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.BgVgR3Jnc7zUNeVX]{Effect: Enlightening Spell}

Fall Upwards.name: Fall Upwards
Fall Upwards.description: The sky calls to you as much as the ground does. Until the start of your next turn, you treat falls as [[/r 20 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value + 0]] shorter, and you increase the distance you Long Jump by [[/r 10 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value + 0]] and High Jump by [[/r 5 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value + 0]]. If your cursebound value is 3 when you use Fall Upwards, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.

Cursed with Sanctity.name: Cursed with Sanctity
Cursed with Sanctity.description: When your mystery takes hold, you become sanctified. When you first gain this feat, choose holy or unholy. When you have the cursebound condition, you are sanctified and gain the corresponding trait as well as a weakness to the opposite trait equal to your level. Your cursebound actions gain your sanctified trait.

Seeds of Divinity.name: Seeds of Divinity
Seeds of Divinity.description:
You create four powerful seeds infused with divine magic. You create 4 seeds of negligible Bulk which appear in one of your open hands, or immediately in 4 squares adjacent to you when you Cast the Spell. You can Release a seed into an adjacent square or Interact to throw the seed at a space within 10 feet. When a seed comes in contact with the ground, it sprouts into a small bush which occupies a 5-foot square and provides concealment. Each bush has [[/r (@item.level - 1) * 10 + 10]] Hit Points and [[/r 10 + 2 * @item.level]] AC.

After 1 round has passed since a bush has sprouted, you can Sustain the spell to force a bush to grow, becoming your choice of hazardous or bountiful when you do, and once a bush has been grown in this way it cannot be selected again.

  • Hazardous The bush becomes hazardous terrain in addition to providing concealment, dealing 2 piercing and poison damage to creatures each time they move through its space.

  • Bountiful The bush produces a single fruit which grants creatures that consume it a status bonus to damage equal to your maximum cursebound value and [[/r 4 + 2 * (@item.level -1)]] temporary Hit Points. These effects last for the duration and fruit produced by the bush decomposes into nothing after the duration has elapsed. A creature can harvest and consume a fruit from a bush as a single Interact action. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.p1kH1shqzQNnBaBJ]{Effect: Seeds of Divinity (Bountiful Bush)}

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points of the bushes increases by 10 and their AC increases by 2. The temporary Hit Points, piercing, and poison damage each increase by 2.

Inevitable Foresight.name: Inevitable Foresight
Inevitable Foresight.description: Your curio’s foresight is undeniable, the futures written as plainly as text. When you attempt the Perception check from Curio’s Foresight, you treat your degree of success as one step better.

Lucid Reality.name: Lucid Reality
Lucid Reality.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

The fabric of reality begins to break, as you shape reality with your dreams. For 1 minute, you have an aura of dreams with a range of 30 feet. When you use Lucid Reality and at the beginning of each turn your aura of dreams is in effect, you create one of the illusory effects described below which lasts until the beginning of your next turn. If you are cursebound 3 when you use Lucid Reality, you instead create up to 3 effects at once and each can be of a different type

  • You create an illusory creature as if you had cast an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} spell with a rank heightened to half your level rounded up. The creature gains its 2 actions for the turn when you spend a single action with the concentrate trait to direct it.

  • You create an illusory barrier that is up to 10 feet high and 10 feet wide. The illusion can be disbelieved if the creature attempts to [[/act seek]], Interact, or otherwise move through the barrier.

  • You create an illusory object as if you had cast an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2oH5IufzdESuYxat]{Illusory Object} spell with a rank heightened to half your level rounded up.

Raise Mountain.name: Raise Mountain
Raise Mountain.description:
Area the cone must be in an area of earth or stone

You feel the weight of your mystery on your shoulders, and move the world to create a mountain. Each square in the area rises 5 feet higher than the previous square, creating a rocky triangular rising or stair-step formation with a height equal to the length of the cone. You can choose to make the area difficult terrain or an easily traversable. If an area of terrain’s height would touch or exceed an obstacle above it, it instead stops within 5 feet of the obstacle, and the area of the spell near the obstacle becomes greater difficult terrain. Creatures in the area must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature can choose to move to the nearest edge or remain in its space.

Success As critical success, but the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of your turn.

Failure The creature is moved to the nearest adjacent space that is not in the area. If this would cause the creature to fall from the raised area, it can attempt to [[/act grab-an-edge]] with the same DC as the spell.

Critical Failure The creature falls prone in the area. If the creature is in an area of greater difficult terrain, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it Escapes.

Heightened (+2) The cone length increases by 5 feet.

The Mystery Grows.name: The Mystery Grows
The Mystery Grows.description:
Your curio’s power is growing rapidly, reawakening ancient powers or becoming a conduit of power to your allies. You gain the following action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.A7RfY8hjBQ4qYReT]{The Mystery Grows}

@Embed[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.A7RfY8hjBQ4qYReT inline]

All-Seer.name: All-Seer
All-Seer.description:
You have visions of things far beyond yourself. You learn @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zvKWclOZ7A53DObE]{Clairvoyance} as a divine spell and add it to your oracle spell repertoire and it is a signature spell for you. When you cast clairvoyance, it gains the following heightened effect:

Heightened (+1) Increase the range by 250 feet.

prerequisites.value: The ability to cast spells from spell slots

Sacrificial Spell.name: Sacrificial Spell
Sacrificial Spell.description: Your healing is extraordinarily powerful, but it saps at your own life force. If your next action is to cast heal and all your targets are living creatures, you roll d12s instead of d8s for the amount of healing.

The Vision is Clear.name: The Vision is Clear
The Vision is Clear.description: The artifact sends you visions to protect you, even from the unseen. You become a master in Perception. You aren’t off-guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures that you have a +2 status bonus to AC and saves against from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Fg25A68hjadgRefp]{Curio’s Foresight}. These creatures can still help their allies flank.

Curse of Impossible Radiance.name: Curse of Impossible Radiance
Curse of Impossible Radiance.description: Your inner light shines so bright that it exudes from your eyes, ears, mouth, and fingertips with blinding extravagance. At all times you exhibit a faint glow of a color that reflects the energy of where your magic originates. When you gain the cursebound condition, you glow so bright that it becomes impossible to hide. You create bright light with a radius equal to your cursebound condition’s value times five, and dim light for an equal number of feet beyond that. You take a status penalty to sight-based Perception checks, Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak, and to Reflex saves against area effects equal to your cursebound value.

Flesh of Cinders.name: Flesh of Cinders
Flesh of Cinders.description: Your flesh flows around physical threats like a cloud of ash. Until the end of your next turn you gain resistance equal to your level against all physical damage, and you gain a status bonus equal to your cursebound condition to saves and DCs against Grapple or effects that would give you the immobilized, grabbed, or restrained conditions.

Curse of Monstrous Change.name: Curse of Monstrous Change
Curse of Monstrous Change.description: You struggle to keep a powerful beast deep within you at bay, and at times, you lose. Even when you are fully in control, marks of the beast can be seen: sharp fangs, slit pupils, more or less hair, scales, and so on. When you are cursebound you take a status penalty to checks with the linguistic trait and to saves against emotion effects equal to your cursebound value, and you take a status penalty equal to half your cursebound value to Will saves (minimum 0).

Embrace Instinct.name: Embrace Instinct
Embrace Instinct.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater.

Entering a dissociative haze, you allow your body to act entirely on instinct and do the fighting for you. When you enter this stance, you become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for as long as you remain in this stance. You can use the additional action only for actions or activities with the cursebound trait.

Promised Renewal.name: Promised Renewal
Promised Renewal.description:
You cause the body of a creature to be consumed by sporadic growth. If the target was a living creature with the dying condition, it must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC or it increases its dying condition by 2 (or by 3 if it critically failed). If the target was a corpse or a living creature that died from failing its Fortitude save, you immediately create an abundant growth of natural plant life in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] of the target, including enveloping the target. The area becomes difficult terrain and minions with the fungus, plant, or wood traits gain fast healing [[/r 3 + 2 * (@item.level - 3)]] while within the emanation. This fast healing applies to effects you create with these traits as well if they have Hit Points, such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree} spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.bAixyu6lyYtnqQGo]{Effect: Promised Renewal}

Heightened (+2) Increase the emanation by 5 feet and the fast healing by 2.

Forest.name: Forest
Forest.description:
Strange things live in the woods, and you often find yourself drawn to go to them and never return. You might once have stumbled into an ancient grove touched by the Plane of Wood, or a chance encounter with the fey may linger with you to this day. Deities like Erastil, Baekho, Gendowyn or the Eldest are commonly venerated by forest oracles, teaching them to look between the trees and find the answers they seek.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.BX5UIAUarWG43Fg2]{Root Reading}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.K9gI08enGtmih5X1]{Protector Tree}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YWrfKetOqDwVFut7]{Oaken Resilience}
  • 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2hMy9ROM2dOZB8Jq]{Lignify}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.6eJzIrMiNtOTzhCR]{Seeds of Divinity}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.EQYDCV6Llp7qvEmf]{Promised Renewal}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.Y8qMgfEFPGlbuN9K]{Wooden Engulfment}

Related Domains nature, travel, trickery, wood

Mystery Skill Nature

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.iWueJXoM6ZFHULZj]{Comfort of Struggle}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.U6pxB24CFi1YhvKe]{Curse of Ancient Growth}

Divine Gnosis.name: Divine Gnosis
Divine Gnosis.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you're in an encounter.

You open up your mind to otherworldly knowledge. When you enter this stance, you can Recall Knowledge with a circumstance bonus to your check equal to your cursebound value and you treat your degree of success on this check as one better. You can Recall Knowledge as a free action while in this stance by giving it the cursebound trait. You must Recall Knowledge on subjects relevant to the current encounter. You do not take the penalties from being stupefied on checks to Recall Knowledge while in this stance.

Intuitive Reveal.name: Intuitive Reveal
Intuitive Reveal.description: You intuit the future without a thought. You gain an additional reaction each turn which you can only use for Reflexive Reveal.

Mystery Cultist.name: Mystery Cultist
Mystery Cultist.description:
Your divine powers have garnered the attention of a disciple. This follower may see you as a nascent deity, might be someone you have performed secretive rites with, or otherwise be dedicated to following you on your journey. They have the minion trait and begin as a novice follower.

Special You gain access to the following additional feats as oracle class feats: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.PPbTc7LjWcH9rhrI]{Additional Follower} (4th), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.UTGVGcpgAbZONOf5]{Experienced Follower} (4th), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.EhKeGvsxotMarUt0]{Veteran Follower} (8th), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.upsDl9drHCoH6jrz]{Exceptional Follower} (14th)

prerequisites.value:
You don’t have an animal companion, construct
companion, or other companion that functions similarly
oracle spellcasting or enlightened reliquarian spellcasting

Vision.name: Vision
Vision.description:
Often, when an oracle is bestowed a mystery, it is without exact purpose. An oracle of flame is given the divine secrets of fire to ruminate on, or an oracle of beasts may be saddled with a monstrous truth. But, on occasion, something accompanies these oracular powers: a vision. A divine message that warns of an avoidable, a great feat that must be done, or something beyond that. The vision grants the oracle gifts, and a heavy responsibility they cannot ignore forever.

An oracle may only have one vision selected, which must be chosen when they first become a member of the oracle class. This vision cannot be changed and represents the goal of your mystery, and how you interact with it.

Your vision provides an alternate domain and granted spell, replacing one domain and spell of your choice associated with your mystery. If the spell you would gain from your vision has the same rank as one of the spells granted by your mystery, you must replace that spell with your vision’s granted spell. You also become trained in the skill granted by your vision instead of becoming trained in Religion from the oracle class, or another skill of your choice if you are already trained in the skill granted by your vision.

When you roll initiative in an encounter, you immediately incur a cursebound value of 1 or increase your cursebound value by 1 if you were already cursebound. While cursebound during an encounter, you are under the effects of your Vision State.

Unlike other oracles, you can use a cursebound action when you are at your maximum cursebound value while within a Vision State, but you treat the effects of your cursebound actions as if your cursebound value was 1 lower than its normal value. If you are at your maximum cursebound value and you use a cursebound action or your cursebound value would increase from your Vision State, you enter your Awakened State instead of increasing your cursebound value and gain its effects then you cannot use cursebound actions until you Refocus after you enter your Awakened State.

When in your Awakened State, you gain all of the effects for your Vision State and Awakened State based on your maximum cursebound value. You remain awakened for a number of rounds equal to your maximum cursebound value, until you would increase your cursebound value due to failing to meet the requirements of your Vision State, until you are knocked unconscious, or the encounter ends, whichever comes first. You cannot use the Cast a Spell activity while awakened unless the spell being cast is granted to you from your mystery granted spells, your Awakened State, an oracle feat, or the Divine Access class feature. After your Awakened State ends, you lose your Vision State effects and cannot enter a Vision State or Awakened State again until you have Refocused.

When your maximum cursebound increases, your Vision and Awakened States becomes more pronounced and powerful, granting you additional benefits as you deepen your relationship with your mystery.

Patristic Followers.name: Patristic Followers
Patristic Followers.description: Your followers are the start of a new church, based around your prophetic teachings. Choose a divine spell of each of the spell ranks from 1 to 7. Your follower can cast each once per day as divine spells. If you have multiple followers, you can distribute these spells among them.

Gloom.name: Gloom
Gloom.description:
The shadows adopted you into the folds of its endless nothingness, as a babe in the arms of a mother of darkness. Perhaps a god of darkness like Count Ranalc or Nocticula saw you as a proper emissary of the dark, or perhaps you were damned by the likes of Zon-Kuthon or Nyarlathotep. Perhaps the netherworld itself made its influence upon you, its powerful energies binding with the likes of your soul. However it happened, the abyss returned your gaze, and now darkness follows your steps.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.QZ7OHptO1xnwaruq]{Penumbral Disguise}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.DeF63UTmr7rchF60]{Wall of Shadow}

Revelation Spells

  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.NFsi2f90SRFobe7H]{Shadowcopy}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.ygUiIHPC2ZQEMcl0]{Web of Darkness}

Dream Logic.name: Dream Logic
Dream Logic.description:
Domain dreams (apocryphal)

In the world of dreams, cause and effect are often disconnected, and the impossible becomes real. You bring dream logic into the real world, filling it with peculiar visions and lapses in logic. All creatures within the aura must make a Will save; on a failure, roll [[/r 1d4]] to determine the results on the table below. On a critical failure, roll twice, taking the result chosen by the caster. Creatures can choose to get the result of a failure on their save.

Roll

Effect

1

Object Fallacy Even things without minds seem to speak here. Until the start of your next turn, you can speak to inanimate objects; they will respond only to you using a language you understand that only you can hear. You have a +1 circumstance bonus to Make a Request or Demoralize while this effect is active.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.lyYMV9N9mRqRxQ5F]{Effect: Dream Logic - Object Fallacy}

2

Static Time Clocks tick irregularly, moving backwards as often as forwards. Effects and conditions with a duration affecting you are extended by 1d4 rounds.

3

Untethered To Ground Gravity acts as more of a suggestion than a rule. The creature gains a fly Speed equal to its land Speed until the end of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.oDiqzXcbYLuT1bN7]{Effect: Dream Logic - Untethered to Ground}

4

Warped Energy Energies are maladapted in the area. Until the end of the creature's turn, if the creature deals acid, cold, electricity, fire or sonic damage, it instead deals another energy damage type (roll 1d4 randomly to determine which other damage type). If a creature would deal more than one type of these damage types, you choose which damage type is altered.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.eAwv3v3Ww9qxsU4W]{Effect: Dream Logic - Warped Energy}

Moonlit Folly.name: Moonlit Folly
Moonlit Folly.description:
Domain moon (apocryphal)

The moon's influence far above becomes noticeable, and you find your emotions and body altered because of it. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed, a +1 status bonus to your Fortitude and Reflex saves, and a –1 status penalty to your Will saves. If the moon is visible, the status bonus to Speed increases by 5 feet and both the bonus and penalty to saves increases to 2. If you Cast the Spell at night during a full moon, you also become quickened and can use the additional action only to Stride.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.08EMkXoFIiMaJcF5]{Effect: Moonlit Folly}

Life of the Party.name: Life of the Party
Life of the Party.description:
You bring party favors for your allies, boosting their morale with potentially overwhelming effects. When you Cast the Spell and at the end of each of your turns for the duration, you immediately fill up to two of your open hands with festive treats for consumption. At any time during the duration, you or an ally within your reach can Interact to consume one of the treats in your hands, gaining 5 temporary Hit Points for 1 minute and a +2 status bonus to damage until the temporary Hit Points are lost. If a creature that has consumed one of your festive treats attempts to consume another before 10 minutes has passed, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. When the spell ends, these effects end and any remaining festive treats you have disappear.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.paSKF0DGRrWtRhXo]{Effect: Life of the Party}

Heightened (+1) The temporary Hit Points increases by 2.

Perfect Understanding.name: Perfect Understanding
Perfect Understanding.description: The vision reveals the ultimate truths to you. You become legendary in Perception. You aren’t off-guard to hidden, undetected, or flanking creatures in your aura of foresight.

Urge Clemency.name: Urge Clemency
Urge Clemency.description:
With a silky smooth voice, you can tell others to forget about what they've seen and move on. You make a check with your @Check[spell|against:will]{spell attack modifier} and compare it against the Will DC of up to 4 creatures within 30 feet of you, with a status bonus to your check equal to your cursebound value. You take a –4 circumstance penalty to this roll if you or an ally recently threatened or harmed any of the target creatures. Regardless of the results of a creature’s save, it is temporarily immune to Urge Clemency for 1 day.

Critical Success Any emotion effects that would affect the creature are suppressed and the creature can't use hostile actions. If the target is subject to hostility from any other creature, this effect ends. The creatures will otherwise ignore you unless threatened while in this state, which lasts for 1 minute. If you and your allies are no longer perceived by the creatures when this effect ends, they forget about encountering you entirely.

Success As a critical success, but the creature remembers the encounter after 1 day has passed.

Failure The creature is aware you tried to affect its mind.

Sense Mystery.name: Sense Mystery
Sense Mystery.description: You innately know when your mystery has touched someone or something. When you come within 30 feet of a creature, location, or object that is somehow involved in your mystery, the GM rolls a secret @Check[perception|traits:secret] check for you to realize it, even if you didn't spend an action to Sense Motive against that creature or if you aren’t Searching for that object or location. This feat does not tell you how your mystery is involved; for example, a bones oracle would not be told if the hooded figure they passed is a necromancer, an undead creature, or an undercover cleric of Pharasma. Meanwhile, a flame oracle would not know what a door touched by their mystery hides, only that it is somehow associated with fire.

Pantraditional Knowledge.name: Pantraditional Knowledge
Pantraditional Knowledge.description:
You have studied spells from all traditions, and your mystery grants them to you in your time of need. You keep a book of spells, similar to a wizard’s spellbook, and can use its spells to supplement your spell repertoire. Add all the spells in your repertoire to this book for free. You can use [[/act learn-a-spell statistic=religion]] to Learn Spells and add them to your spellbook by paying the appropriate cost.

During your daily preparations, choose any one spell from your book of spells. If that spell is already in your spell repertoire, you can treat it as an additional signature spell that day. If it isn’t in your repertoire, treat it as though it were until your next daily preparations. You can cast spells that are not of the divine tradition if they are prepared in this manner, however, when you Cast a Spell you learned in this way from another tradition, it gains the cursebound trait.

Song.name: Song
Song.description:
You are haunted by a mysterious piece of music wherever you go. It plays in the winds, in the voices of your friends, in the echo of your own voice. Perhaps it is a gift from a deity like Shelyn or Gogunta. Maybe you were witness to an occult masterpiece that has stayed with you for years. Though nobody else can hear it, all other sound bends into its tune—subtly or not.

Terrible Size.name: Terrible Size
Terrible Size.description:
Your inner beast transforms your physique. You grow to size Large and your equipment grows with you, but returns to natural size if removed. You become clumsy 1 and your reach increases by 5 feet (or by 10 feet if you were Tiny). You gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds. This does not end morph effects that do not affect your size, such as body of the beast.

Heightened (5th) You can choose to instead grow to size Huge. The status bonus to Speeds increases to a +20-foot status bonus, and your reach increases by 10 feet (or 15 feet if you were Tiny).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.9mDckQWMjaJjxL79]{Effect: Terrible Size}

Enlightened Reliquarian.name: Enlightened Reliquarian
Enlightened Reliquarian.description:
When magic is too great to sustain with the body, it is imbued into an object. With time, the power within these items grows, and they become artifacts. While some artifacts are lost over the millenia, and others are sealed away, some are found again. And sometimes, one becomes the focus of an oracle’s mystery.

Whether guided to the relic by fate or by creating a miraculous tool themselves, Enlightened Reliquarians channel the power of the divine through a strange curio. These curios are sacred artifacts and relics, and are generally associated with the mystery of the oracle. For example, a battle mystery oracle with a weapon curio may be wielding a sword once used by Iomedae herself. Meanwhile, a flame oracle’s utensil might be a bottle of lit oil carrying an ancient ritual fire, kept alight for centuries.

Curse of the Reliquarian 1st

As the oracle shares its mystery with the relic, there is simultaneously more and less strain from their powers placed on them. With less raw divine magic flowing through them, the oracle is less ravaged by their curse. Without the clouding haze of magic a traditional oracle suffers through, an enlightened reliquarian can truly see and understand their mystery. You must select @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.1EUmjV0gH1eYFizZ]{Enlightened Reliquarian Dedication} as your 2nd-level class feat.

Prerequisites You must be an oracle.

Class Feature Adustments:

  • You don't gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.iwAzV1IlQ2pMHQoB]{Divine Access} class feature.

  • You don't gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.571c1aGnvNVwfF6b]{Oracular Clarity} class feature.

  • You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.eTQZQGPMIZJHIR6J]{Oracular Senses} class feature at 1st level instead of 11th level.

  • You also gain the following class features and adjustments:

Spellcasting Adjustment: Your spellcasting capabilities are more restricted. At 1st level, you can cast one 1st-rank spell and five cantrips. As you increase in level, your number of spell slots and the highest rank of spells you can cast from spell slots increases, shown in Enlightened Reliquarian Spells per Day. Because the power of your mystery is mostly contained within your sibylline artifact, you have no more than two spell slots of your highest rank and, if you can cast 2nd-rank spells or higher, two spell slots of 1 rank lower than your highest spell rank. For anything that requires the ability to cast spells of a certain rank that's lower than the highest slots you have, you still qualify even if you no longer have spell slots at those ranks.
