Spellcasting Repertoire Adjustment: The collection of spells you can cast is called your spell repertoire. At 1st level, you learn two 1st-rank spells of your choice and five cantrips of your choice. You choose these from the common spells from the divine tradition, or from other spells from that tradition to which you have access. You can cast any spell in your spell repertoire by using a spell slot of an appropriate spell level. Your spell slots and the spells in your spell repertoire are separate. If a feat or other ability adds a spell to your spell repertoire, such as granted spells from your oracle mystery, it doesn't give you another spell slot, and vice versa.

You add to this spell repertoire as you increase in level. Each time you get a spell slot, you add a spell of the same level to your spell repertoire. At 2nd level, you select another 1st-rank spell. At 3rd level, you add the first 2nd-rank spell to your repertoire. At 4th level you gain your second and your spell repertoire reaches its maximum size of five spells.

At 5th level, in addition to adding two 3rd-rank spells to your repertoire, you lose your lowest rank of spell slots. Any time you lose a rank of spell slots, you lose two spells in your repertoire as well. These can come from spells you already know or out of the number of new spells you're learning. On levels in which you don't change your spell slots, you can swap out multiple spells, as described below.

Swapping Spells in Your Repertoire: As you gain new spells in your repertoire, you might want to replace some of the spells you previously learned. Each time you gain a level and learn new spells, you can swap out one of your old spells for a different spell of the same rank. If it's a level at which you lose a set of lower-rank slots, you can replace the two in either order. You can also instead swap a cantrip. You can also swap out spells by retraining during downtime.

At 6th level and every even level thereafter, you can swap out any number of your spells for different spells of a level you can cast. When you do, you must keep at least one spell you can cast with your lowest level of spell slots so you don't end up with slots you can't use. For instance, at 6th level you would need to keep at least one 2nd-rank spell, but all your other spells could be 3rd rank.

Contagious Festivities.name: Contagious Festivities
Contagious Festivities.description:
You know how to kick things off when it gets hectic, dancing around the battlefield, consuming to your hearts content, and getting others to partake in the festivities. You attempt to coax a creature within 10 feet of you into engaging in festivities by having the target attempt a @Check|will|against:spell] save. If you target an ally, they can choose to get a result of a failure on their save without rolling.

Critical Success The creature rebukes your attempts to coax it and is temporarily immune to future attempts for 1 minute.

Success The creature is slightly bemused by your attempts, it cannot take hostile action against you until the end of its next turn. If you take a hostile action against the creature, it becomes temporarily immune to this effect for 1 minute.

Failure The creature indulges you. As success, the creature must also use one of its actions to [[/act perform]] or to consume food or drink or it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}. After it completes the action, it gains a status bonus to damage equal to twice your cursebound value until the end of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.z6Hq3CfTIt2XoSx8]{Effect: Contagious Festivities}

Critical Failure The creature becomes lost in the moment. As failure, except the creature must use all of its actions to engage in the festivities and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} until the end of your next turn.

Overwhelming Festivities.name: Overwhelming Festivities
Overwhelming Festivities.description:
You exude festivity and resplendent indulgence, throttling emotions, causing them to overwhelm the mind. When an enemy in the emanation fails a save against an emotion effect or gains the frightened condition from an effect, it also takes 3d4 persistent mental damage.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.m7RLoqSYkgvv8pyz]{Aura: Overwhelming Festivities}

Heightened (+2) The persistent damage increases by 1d4 and the radius of the emanation increases by 5 feet.

Sensory Roots.name: Sensory Roots
Sensory Roots.description:
Your curse takes root on the ground beneath you, allowing you to sense the surrounding area. You force the growths of your curse to take root beneath you. You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet for as long as you are cursebound. At the end of each turn you are cursebound, you become immobilized by your roots if you have not used an action with the move trait this turn. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Sensory Roots, your tremorsense is a precise sense in the first 15 feet of its range instead of an imprecise sense, and if you are cursebound 3, your tremorsense has a range of 60 feet instead of 30 feet.

Foundry Note Due to system implementation, a precise sense will always "beat" an imprecise sense, thus, you will never be able to see or make use of the imprecise tremorsense from this feat at cursebound 2 or above. You must handle this manually.

Cryptic Murmurings.name: Cryptic Murmurings
Cryptic Murmurings.description:
Trigger You end an encounter in which your cursebound value was 2 or greater and you are conscious.

At times, you mutter grim warnings of things to come—and not even you might understand what you mean. You or an ally within 15 feet of you when you uttered the murmur, can spend 10 minutes to attempt a @Check[religion|against:spell|overrideTraits:true|traits:secret] check against your spellcasting DC to decipher what the murmur might mean. This check must be attempted in the next hour, or the murmur’s meaning is lost. This check has the secret trait and the following results.

Critical Success You learn of something desperately important. Your GM warns you of an upcoming encounter or danger; for example, if your murmur was “the shell walks the steps”, you would learn of a graveknight lurking near a nearby stairwell. You gain the effects of a critical success with Recall Knowledge on a creature or subject of the encounter or danger. You and your allies gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Initiative for the relevant encounter as long as it occurs within the next day.

Success Deciphering your riddle is vague, but gives you some glimpses into what could come to pass. You learn two interpretations of your riddle, one correct and one incorrect. For example, with “the shell walks the steps”, it may hint at a graveknight, or it may be about a crab-like jah-tohl patrolling the area. You and your allies gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Initiative for the relevant encounter as long as it occurs within the next day.

Failure You fail to decipher the riddle.

Critical Failure You come to the wrong understanding. You learn an incorrect piece of information, such as only learning about jah-tohls. You and your allies have a –2 circumstance penalty to Initiative for the relevant encounter as long as it occurs within the next day.

Shadowcopy.name: Shadowcopy
Shadowcopy.description:
You shed your shadow as a snake sheds its skin, producing a silhouette of you that walks autonomously. You create a shadowcopy of yourself in an adjacent space which is the same size as you, but otherwise can be moved through normally. All creatures within the area of the shadowcopy become concealed, and all creatures outside the area become concealed to creatures within it. You can move the shadowcopy up to your Speed to an area you can see when you Cast the Spell and when you Sustain the spell. Once during the duration of the spell, you can use the Shadow Swap free action, after which the spell ends and the shadowcopy disappears.

Shadow Swap f (concentrate, darkness, oracle, shadow)

Effect You swap places with your shadow in a burst of darkness. You create magical darkness that lasts until the end of your next turn in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] around the position of your shadowy duplicate and yourself. You can choose to change positions with your shadow when you use this action, and if you do, the spell gains the teleportation trait.

Curse of Ancestral Meddling (Team+).name: Curse of Ancestral Meddling (Team+)
Curse of Ancestral Meddling (Team+).description: The ancestral spirits you commune with haunt you and meddle with your belongings and actions, either out of a wellintentioned (but ultimately detrimental) attempt to assist you, as punishment for your audacity in circumventing the traditional means of achieving divine power, for their own amusement, or a mixture of the above. When you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} condition, you are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy} with a value equal to your cursebound value. When you use a cursebound action, you immediately suppress the clumsy condition from your curse until the end of your next turn.

Cursebound Foresight.name: Cursebound Foresight
Cursebound Foresight.description:
Actions 1 to 3

Your artifact enables you to tap into its power while foreseeing danger. You use Curio’s Foresight and then a cursebound action or activity that requires 1-, 2-, or 3-actions to use, using the same number of actions as the cursebound action.

The End is Nigh.name: The End is Nigh
The End is Nigh.description:
You call out the terrible futures that await the target, sharing the doom you suffer from with them. Your target must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result, a creature is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Success You see your own fate closing in on you and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target fears the inevitability of their future and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and cannot reduce their frightened condition below 1 for the duration of the spell. The next time the target attempts an attack roll or save, it must roll twice and take the lower result, after which the spell ends.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

The Land Protects Us.name: The Land Protects Us
The Land Protects Us.description: Though you often serve as a protector of the land, the land can also serve to protect you. You create a wall of natural terrain that sprouts from the ground in a 15-foot radius around you that is 10 feet high and lasts for 1 minute. Creatures that attempt to pass through the barrier must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:spell] save, or they take @Damage[2d8[persistent,bleed]]{2d8 persistent bleed} damage. If you’re cursebound 2 when you use The Land Protects Us, the barrier is 20 feet high and the persistent bleed damage is @Damage[3d8[persistent,bleed]]{3d8}, and if you’re cursebound 3, it is instead 30 feet high and the persistent bleed damage increases to @Damage[4d8[persistent,bleed]]{4d8}.

Glacial Sculpting.name: Glacial Sculpting
Glacial Sculpting.description:
Domain cold (apocryphal)

You create a temporary object out of ice. It must be a solid object and 5 cubic feet or smaller. It can't rely on intricate artistry or complex moving parts, never fulfills a cost or the like, has a hardness of 5, and is made entirely of ice. It is obviously temporarily constructed of ice, and thus can't be sold or passed off as a genuine item. If the object is exposed to fire or heat, the duration is reduced 1 round for each round it remains exposed.

Heightened (+1) The amount of cubic feet you can create increases by 3.

Divine Eclipse.name: Divine Eclipse
Divine Eclipse.description:
The world around you falls as dark as the night, leaving you a glowing portal to Creation’s Forge eclipsed only by your own mortal form. You extinguish all non-magical light effects and attempt to counteract any other magical light in the area.

Select up to 5 creatures in the area; you grant them the eclipse’s blessing, they exude bright light in a 5-foot emanation (and dim light 5 feet thereafter) and gain fast healing 6 while within the emanation. All other creatures in the area that end their turn in an area of dim light or darkness take 6d4 cold damage with a basic Reflex save.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.WbVS2UZMIINwpNBZ]{Effect: Divine Eclipse}

Heightened (+1) The cold damage increases by 1d4 and the fast healing increases by 1.

Mind's Eye Wink.name: Mind's Eye Wink
Mind's Eye Wink.description:
You manifest your dreams as an illusory hazard.

  • Area (4 continguous 5-foot squares) All solid ground in the area is a brilliant burst of colors from the Dreamlands. Creatures in the area or that enter the area must make a Will save. A creature that fails its save is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} as long as they are in the area and for 1 round after they leave. On a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} while in the area and stupefied 1 for 1 round after they leave the area.

  • Target (1 object of Bulk 1 or less) If you cast the spell on an unattended object, anyone trying to pick up the object must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or they believe the object is dangerous and would do them harm. If you target an attended object or a creature picks up the unattended object, the creature that has the object must attempt a Will save. On a failure, the wielder takes a –1 circumstance penalty to all checks that involve using the object; or a –2 circumstance on a critical failure. A creature can attempt to disbelieve the effect as normal after using a [[/act seek]] action. If it successfully disbelieves, it ignores the effect for the remaining duration. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.JiB9kUl9RapPQ3Cr]{Effect: Mind's Eye Wink}

Apocryphal Mastery.name: Apocryphal Mastery
Apocryphal Mastery.description: You understand your domain in its entirety, both the aspects commonly understood and those shrouded in secrets. During your daily preparations, select a domain you have a domain spell for and has an apocryphal variant domain spell. You can choose to know either the standard domain spell or the apocryphal domain spell today.

Sharp Note.name: Sharp Note
Sharp Note.description:
You let loose a discordant song that opens your target up to hear the song. Each creature in the area takes 1d8 sonic damage and must attempt a Fortitude save. A creature deafened by the spell can still hear you and is affected by your auditory effects normally.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, is deafened for 1 minute, and takes @Damage[(@item.level)[sonic,persistent]] damage as long as it is deafened.

Heightened (+1) The sonic damage increases by 1d8 and the persistent sonic damage increases by 1.

Reflexive Reveal.name: Reflexive Reveal
Reflexive Reveal.description:
Trigger An ally within the aura of your Curio’s Foresight is the target of a Strike or effect that would require a saving throw.

You can reveal protective visions to your allies outside your protection. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Js9vTrVqDJQeZ2uP]{Reveal the Mystery} on the triggering ally.

Aspirations of the Acolyte.name: Aspirations of the Acolyte
Aspirations of the Acolyte.description:
Your followers have seen the ways of your mystery and aspire to such divinity by pledging themselves to its ways. You can spend 2 actions to Direct Follower, granting them the ability to Cast a Spell.

Each day during your daily preparations, you can choose to give one of your followers two cantrips you can cast from your oracle spellcasting as divine cantrips. If you have more than one follower, you can choose to give all of your followers one cantrip you can cast from your oracle spellcasting as a divine cantrip, with all of your followers gaining the same cantrip.

Spiraling Dance.name: Spiraling Dance
Spiraling Dance.description:
Domain creation (apocryphal)

You express the joy of creation through a spiralling dance that sweeps others up in it. You Stride up to your Speed. You can attempt to [[/act shove statistic=spell]] a single creature adjacent to you during this move, using your spell attack modifier instead of your Athletics modifier if it is higher. The first time each turn after the first you Sustain the spell, you can Stride again and attempt to Shove a single creature adjacent to you during your move.

Dream.name: Dream
Dream.description:
The mind is the greatest creator, for in its folds are forged a thousand worlds in the land of dreams. Your imagination is so persistent and powerful that it forms illusions by your mere presence. You might have close ties to the likes of Desna, the Great Old One Bokrug or some other ancient power from the realm of slumber. You find that the power of the Dreamlands is only a flicker of magic away.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0zU8CPejjQFnhZFI]{Figment}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.o4lRVTwSxnOOn5vl]{Sleep}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.yM3KTTSAIHhyuP14]{Dream Message}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.U58aQWJ47VrI36yP]{Hallucination}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.OpJmCs3zAXmN4mnX]{Mind's Eye Wink}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.kRd321XLgebXcpni]{Wishful Thinking}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.2OSGe5NaTHXHXHGg]{Dream Come True}

Related Domains disorientation, dreams, glyph, nightmares

Mystery Skill Occultism

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.wZz04xU4HejpGTd4]{Astral Daydream}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.x6SPAkbSDUbZqLrc]{Curse of Eternal Reverie}

Accursed Curio.name: Accursed Curio
Accursed Curio.description:
You are cursed to forever be bonded to an accursed curio, a sacred relic empowered by your mystery. You begin with a seemingly mundane item of that type, and you gain the listed benefits associated with your choice. Attempts to rid yourself of the curio generally fail; it will always appear in your possessions when you make your daily preparations, even if it was destroyed. Coins exchanged to sell it blacken and curl like rotting petals moments after you receive them, and purchasers mysteriously find new money to replace the lost money soon after. If you acquire a new object of the same general type as your curio, you can combine the curio and the new object by spending a day of downtime performing rituals to do so. This gives your artifact a slightly different appearance and the abilities of the combined item; for example, a lore oracle could combine their script curio–an ancient tome of handwritten notes written by Gruhastha–with a brooch of inspiration, giving the curio the properties of the item. If this process is repeated, the previous item is removed from the curio, and the new item and your accursed curio are combined. Invested items merged with your curio in this way do not count towards your daily limit of invested items.

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Fg25A68hjadgRefp]{Curio’s Foresight} action and the following benefits depending on your selection of curio. You cannot use cursebound actions unless your object is wielded or worn, as defined in the curio.

Ice.name: Ice
Ice.description:
Ice encrusts your heart, and cold pulses through your veins. It is ever-present, a clinging phantom that saps away all warmth and joy and fills you with a grim numbness. You may draw your powers from the Princess of Rime Algenweis, the polar werebear frost giant god Yrmidar, Uvuko of the Mwangi Expanse, or even from the spirits of the Crown of the World itself. Whatever the source of your power, the bitter cold follows you no matter where you go.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8TQiFzGf4feoHeH0]{Chilling Spray}
  • 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.kHyjQbibRGPNCixx]{Ice Storm}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.xxWhyl81w3ckslAU]{Howling Blizzard}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.hX9AndfKK4fUf4XX]{Freezing Cold}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.UkQm3EFrh7FjhMQX]{Ice Guardian}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.UmP8nuC0f2DiMZOB]{Fractal Frosting}

Related Domains cold, death, pain, travel

Mystery Skill Survival

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.iWueJXoM6ZFHULZj]{Comfort of Struggle}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.WkHeAsDV5cy2JkSr]{Curse of Gelid Presence}

Hand in the Dark.name: Hand in the Dark
Hand in the Dark.description:
Requirements You are adjacent to a shadow or in an area of darkness.

You reach your hand into the shadows as a portal to other shadows. At the beginning of each turn the spell is active, choose a square within range that has a shadow in it. You treat yourself as being in the chosen square for the purposes of Interact actions, and you can target creatures with your spells with a range of touch or a melee spell attack roll as if you were in the chosen square. If the chosen square no longer has a shadow in it, such as if a nearby creature moves, you lose this effect until you choose a new square at the beginning of your next turn.

Assume Destiny.name: Assume Destiny
Assume Destiny.description:
Trigger An ally fails a save against an effect that targeted both of you, and your save was successful.

When a terrible fate awaits your friends, you often see it coming and prepare to take on the role of a martyr. Using your limited control over what you see, you trade fates with your ally, swapping the results of your roll after any modifications to the final result.

Heightened (7th) If your ally’s original result was a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

Hermit's Shelter.name: Hermit's Shelter
Hermit's Shelter.description:
Cost the Price of the chosen items

No matter where you walk, it seems that you can find your shelter nearby. You can spend 10 minutes consulting visions or vague memories of a shelter nearby. The cabin appears somewhere within a 500-foot emanation of you, usually out of line of sight or seemingly innocuously out of view. This shelter has the same specifications and effects as one produced by a cozy cabin spell, but its structure and resplendence is always dependent on the region in which it is found.

The cabin always has sustenance for up to 10 creatures and up to 2 common items of your choice with a level no higher than half your level. These items must be pieces of adventuring gear or consumable items, and can’t be weapons, armor, permanent magic items, or other treasure.

Even though the structure is permanent, it mysteriously fades from view immediately after you move more than 500 feet from the shelter and cannot be found again until you discover it again using Hermit’s Shelter. Any creatures or objects left inside the shelter appear somewhere outside the shelter within 10 feet.

Curse of Ancient Growth.name: Curse of Ancient Growth
Curse of Ancient Growth.description: A feeling of homesickness gnaws at you as you walk the world, and when you are left alone, you hear the psithurism of the forest. The creaking trees, the distant birdsong, and the allconsuming temptation to wander back to those woods and never come back. Plants or fungi may grow on you or your belongings, and woodland creatures appear like omens wherever you go. When you have the cursebound condition and are in darkness or dim light, your growths use your body for sustenance, taking @Damage[(@actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[poison,persistent]|immutable]{persistent poison damage equal to your cursebound value} or @Damage[(2 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[poison,persistent]|immutable]{twice your cursebound value} if you are in total darkness. When you are in bright light, you immediately stop taking persistent poison damage from your curse, as your plants soak up the light instead, producing growths that obscure your vision. While in bright light, creatures beyond 60 feet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} to you, and you reduce the distance you can see creatures clearly by 10 feet for each cursebound value you possess above 1 (with creatures beyond 30 feet concealed to you at cursebound 4). Your growth ceases when you begin Refocusing to assuage your curse or if you fall unconscious, but your growth resumes its behavior if your Refocus activity is interrupted or when you return to consciousness.

Golden Touch.name: Golden Touch
Golden Touch.description:
Domain wealth (apocryphal)

Your hand transmutes anything it touches to gold. The target must make a Fortitude save; If the target is an object held by a creature, the creature makes the Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target transmutes partially into gold. The target gains a weakness 4 to bludgeoning and electricity damage. The target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to Stealth checks or applies this penalty to any creature holding it if it was an item.

Failure The transmutation is more powerful. As success, but the weakness to bludgeoning and electricity is doubled. If the target is a creature, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}. If the target is an object, it grants a –2 circumstance penalty to checks or DCs made with the object if it is not already made of gold.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} as if made of gold for the duration. If the target was an object, it is treated as having the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6dNUvdb1dhToNDj3]{Broken} condition if it is not already made of gold.

Heightened (+1) The weakness to bludgeoning and electricity on success increases by 1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.TwARzUtpp7SCSpEX]{Effect: Golden Touch}

Fantasms of Fire.name: Fantasms of Fire
Fantasms of Fire.description: Smoke and flickering visions of flame fill your senses, and harmless flickers of obscuring flames also fill your space. You create smoke in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] that provides concealment that lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind. You ignore concealment inside the smoke, but treat all creatures outside the smoke as concealed to you, as mysterious fantasms flash within the flames. Creatures inside the smoke cannot see outside the smoke even if they have smoke vision or a similar ability that would allow them to ignore the effects of concealment from smoke. Creatures that need to breath that end their turn in the area take @Damage[(@actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[fire]]{fire damage equal to your cursebound value}. If your cursebound value is 2 when you use Fantasms of Fire, the emanation is a @Template[emanation|distance:20], and if your cursebound value is 3 when you use Fantasms of Fire, the emanation is a @Template[emanation|distance:30].

Ice Guardian.name: Ice Guardian
Ice Guardian.description:
You create a guardian made of ice to defend you. An ice sculpture of Large size appears adjacent to you and attempts to defend you and your allies. You and your allies gain lesser cover while you are adjacent to the guardian, and you can Sustain the spell to increase the cover it grants to standard cover until the beginning of your next turn or to move the guardian to another area by having it Stride with its land Speed of 25 feet. The guardian can be destroyed and has [[/r 30+(@item.level -3)*10]] Hit Points, an AC of [[/r 22+(@item.level -3)*3]], [[/r 3+(@item.level -3)*3]] weakness to bludgeoning damage, and immunity to cold.

Heightened (+1) The guardian’s AC and weakness increases by 3, and its Hit Points increase by 10.

Curse of the Ancient Summit.name: Curse of the Ancient Summit
Curse of the Ancient Summit.description: The weight of the mountains you are bound to are always felt on your shoulders and actions. In moments of stillness, your skin almost resembles stone, and you might find moss growing on you after a restful night's sleep. As your curse advances, you begin to petrify. While Cursebound, you cannot benefit from status bonuses to your Speeds and you cannot be mounted, if you were already mounted, you fall prone off your mount when you become cursebound. You additionally have a status penalty to your Speed equal to 5 feet x your cursebound value or double this amount to any fly or swim Speeds you possess. If your land Speed would be reduced to 5 or lower you retain a land Speed of 10 feet; If any other Speed you possess is reduced to 0 or lower, you cannot use the corresponding movement type.

Fractal Frosting.name: Fractal Frosting
Fractal Frosting.description:
The frost lives on the fringe of your fingertips, splitting into tiny fractures of freezing rays. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.IxhGEKl63R4QBvkj]{Frostbite} as part of casting fractal frosting. For the duration of fractal frosting, you can cast frostbite with a range of 60 feet, targeting up to three different targets within range. You create difficult terrain in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] in the area around each of the targets that lasts for 1 round.

Heightened (9th) For the duration, when you cast frostbite, the target takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speed for 1 round on a failure or a –15-foot status penalty to its Speed on a critical failure.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.OPBNdJPRJgcGVqp1]{Effect: Fractal Frosting}

Curse of Inevitable Rot (Team+).name: Curse of Inevitable Rot (Team+)
Curse of Inevitable Rot (Team+).description:
Your magic is a constant reminder that all creatures will eventually submit to the ravages of time and the environment. You are suffused with an aura of decay. Leaves wilt and insects fall out of the sky as you pass, silverware tarnishes in your hands, and the dregs of wine turn to vinegar in your goblet.

Cursebound 1 You gain weakness 2 to acid and poison damage.

Cursebound 2 You take a –1 status penalty to saving throws against diseases and poisons. In addition, anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds takes a –1 status penalty to the associated skill check.

Cursebound 3 Your weakness to acid and poison damage increases to 10 + your level.

Cursebound 4 Your status penalty to saving throws against diseases and poisons and the status penalty for anyone attempting to Treat your Disease, Poison, or Wounds increases to –2.

Juggernaut of Jagged Stone.name: Juggernaut of Jagged Stone
Juggernaut of Jagged Stone.description:
You call upon the mountain within, and you become its avatar. Rock formations form on your skin, giving you the appearance of a living mountain. You gain resistance 6 to physical damage, except adamantine. You're immune to death effects, disease, drained, fatigued, healing, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, vitality, and void; any of those conditions you had when the spell is cast are suspended until the spell ends, then return with their remaining duration when the spell ends.

Your fist Strikes have a 1d10 damage die, lose the finesse and agile traits, and gain the shove trait, and you become Large in size and are clumsy 1.

In this form, you don't need to breathe. Your Bulk is 24, and you become too dense to Swim in water, automatically sinking to the bottom. You can Dismiss the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.MzalS4gzqOn5NTr8]{Effect: Juggernaut of Jagged Stone}

Heightened (+1) The physical resistance increases by 1.

Trepidation Spell.name: Trepidation Spell
Trepidation Spell.description: When exerting your will over the mind of a creature, you send them harrowing visions of the future. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that is at least 2 ranks below your maximum rank and requires a Will save, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} on a failure or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure. If the creature is immune to emotion, fear, or mental effects, it is immune to this frightened condition.

Vision of the Perfect Creation.name: Vision of the Perfect Creation
Vision of the Perfect Creation.description:
Your vision showed you something beautiful that is yet to exist, and you are to be a part of its creation. An ancestors oracle might be shown four fractured lenses slotted into a fulcrum, or a light oracle might see five glowing stars orbiting a tower.

Alternate Domain creation

Alternate Granted Spell 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.UKsIOWmMx4hSpafl]{Dizzying Colors}

Granted Skill Performance

Vision State Creation is your purpose. While cursebound, when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} it counts as having prepared to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HCl3pzVefiv9ZKQW]{Aid} your ally on their next attack roll or skill check of your choice. When you later use the Aid reaction, you can roll [[/act aid statistic=performance]] instead of the normal skill check. After the first turn in an encounter, if you end a turn without using Perform or a cursebound action that turn, you increase your cursebound value by 1 up to your maximum cursebound value.

Awakened State You can Perform as a free action at the end of each of your turns and if you roll a failure on your Performance check to Aid, you get a success instead. If your cursebound value is 3, you automatically critically succeed at your checks to Aid using Performance. If your cursebound value is 4, you gain an additional reaction each turn you can only use to Aid using Performance.

Revelry.name: Revelry
Revelry.description:
You are granted mystic insight through acts of hedonism or intoxication. It might be that you have celebrated too hard that you have gained the favor of deities like Cayden Cailean, Urgathoa, Marishi or Sun Wukong; alternatively, you might come from a tradition that uses powerful hallucinogens to induce states of heightened awareness. Whatever form your revelry takes, being in a state of intoxication gives you a connection to the divine that nobody else can reach.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VACvA5VRbddjt5s9]{Infectious Enthusiasm}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pBevG6bSQOiyflev]{Befuddle}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.q5qmNn144ZJGxnvJ]{Befitting Attire}
  • 7th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vPWMEyVTreMOoFnm]{Planar Palace}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.IwJEKkV4PX7pY3V9]{Life of the Party}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.LsoSNdvocpMcOZLv]{Overwhelming Festivities}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.uLzgBltYNdU8hmJZ]{The More The Merrier}

Related Domains disorientation, indulgence, passion, wealth

Mystery Skill Performance

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.mLRt0nJQLvbZkiml]{Well of Joy}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.ZamwPUeVau0UltXC]{Curse of the Eternal Banquet}

Ray of Light.name: Ray of Light
Ray of Light.description:
You shoot a beam of light from your hands, dispelling darkness and blinding enemies. All creatures in the area must make a basic Fortitude save or take 1d6 fire damage. Creatures with the shadow trait or with light blindness take a –2 status penalty to their save. Creatures that fail their save are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round and then dazzled for 1 minute if it was a critical failure. The spell leaves an ambient light in each square of the area which sheds like a torch for 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) Increase the fire damage by 1d6 and the distance of the line by 5 feet.

Curse of Gelid Presence.name: Curse of Gelid Presence
Curse of Gelid Presence.description:
The cold clings to you like a ghost haunting your every moment and numbing you to your core. Even in warm weather, your breath condenses as if it were freezing, and patches of ice sometimes appear on your clothes or hair. Your frost subsides when you begin Refocusing to assuage your curse or if you fall unconscious, but the frost resumes its behavior if your Refocus activity is interrupted or when you return to consciousness.

Cursebound 1 Frost forms on your skin. You take @Damage[1[cold,persistent]|immutable] damage.

Cursebound 2 You cannot Step. This applies to any creature you mount in addition to yourself.

Cursebound 3 The persistent cold damage increases to @Damage[3[cold,persistent]|immutable]{3}.

Cursebound 4 At the beginning of each of your turns, you reduce all of your Speeds by 10 feet to a minimum of 0 feet. If all of your Speeds are reduced to 0, you instead become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} by your ice and must [[/act escape]] against your spell DC to move again. If you successfully Escape, all your Speeds are no longer reduced, and then the cycle continues, and the ice starts to reduce your Speed again. Your curses’ penalties to Speed and the immobilized condition apply to creatures you mount instead of yourself while mounted. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.yRNC7m3QIS6GVdvz]{Effect: Curse of Gelid Presence}

Wield the Divine.name: Wield the Divine
Wield the Divine.description: You access the divine directly, even if it is agonizing to do so. You gain 1 Focus Point.

Mountain.name: Mountain
Mountain.description:
Your soul is linked to the eternal stone that makes up mountains. Perhaps you have a divine connection to a particular range of mountains such as the Kortos Mountains, the Wall of Heaven in Tian Xia, or the mountain that makes up the realm of Heaven itself. Maybe you have the blessing of deities such as Yamatsumi, Balumbdar or Ragdya. Whatever the case, you yourself are towering stone, and your powers manifest as such.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zA0jNIBRgLsyTpbm]{Scatter Scree}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.dgCH2E0gMLMUgyFl]{Shockwave}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KEagmnwgsSbGmkme]{Cave Fangs}
  • 6th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA]{Petrify}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.tmGuPJr7ppxurTzP]{Seismic Shift}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.8p4xVEywQr8pN5QN]{Raise Mountain}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.VK8P3zkoyrVI1RO7]{Juggernaut of Jagged Stone}

Related Domains earth, might, travel, vigil

Mystery Skill Athletics

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.yiPogNDpDqAXlqTJ]{Hardened to Suffering}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.UlxAZtgVV8KaKGWS]{Curse of the Ancient Summit}

Creature's Howl.name: Creature's Howl
Creature's Howl.description:
You unleash an awful roar at your opponents, enough to chill them to the bones. All enemies in the area that can hear your howl must attempt a Will save. Regardless of their result, they become temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (9th) The area increases to a 60-foot emanation.

The Hour of Rallying.name: The Hour of Rallying
The Hour of Rallying.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

The body is but a vessel for your mystery, easily subjected by its divinity. You attempt to @Check[counteract] the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied} conditions of yourself and all allies within 30 feet of you. You gain a status bonus to your check equal to your cursebound value.

Spirit Squire.name: Spirit Squire
Spirit Squire.description:
You can summon a squire that aids you in battle. For 1 minute, you gain a summoned squire which can carry items and swap them out for you on a whim. When you use this action and each turn for the duration, your squire gains a single action it can only use to Interact to draw, stow, or swap an item you have in your possession. If you’re cursebound 2 when you use Spirit Squire, your squire can choose to grant you a +1 circumstance bonus to your AC until the beginning of your next turn with its Interact action to protect you instead of using it to draw, stow, or swap an item, and if you’re cursebound 3 when you use Spirit Squire, it can grant both effects with the same Interact action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.t3fbScIIFlfyffRK]{Effect: Spirit Squire}

Curse of Countless Fates.name: Curse of Countless Fates
Curse of Countless Fates.description:
As you gaze further and further into the future, an immense pressure settles over you, leaving you more and more helpless to look away from the infinite possibilities laid before you. Your eyes are a milky white, or you might have a third eye which always looks forward, a single cyclopean eye, a blindfold you can't remove or some other effect affecting your eyes.

Cursebound 1 You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}. This doomed condition lasts only while your cursebound value is 1 or greater.

Cursebound 2 You take a –1 status penalty to Perception checks and to saves against death effects as visions of the future overwhelm you.

Cursebound 3 You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}. This doomed condition lasts only while your cursebound value is 3 or greater.

Cursebound 4 Your status penalty to Perception checks and to saves against death effects increases to –2.

Ominous Threats.name: Ominous Threats
Ominous Threats.description: Your words carry a mysterious weight to them. You use [[/act demoralize]], but it loses the auditory trait and you do not suffer a penalty for not sharing a language, as you send ominous visions to the mind of the individual. You gain a status bonus equal to your check equal to your cursebound value.

Wooden Engulfment.name: Wooden Engulfment
Wooden Engulfment.description:
You grow a tree from the ground, which latches onto your enemies with its branches. You create a tree in the designated area, and creatures in the area are immediately moved to an adjacent square of their choice they could occupy. The tree is [[/r 40 + (@item.level - 6) *5]] feet high and has [[/r 60 + (@item.level - 6) *10]] Hit Points, AC [[/r 30 + (@item.level - 6) *3]], a reach of 15 feet, and is permanently @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}.

When you first Cast the Spell and each time you Sustain the spell, you can attempt a spell attack roll against the Reflex DC of a target within the tree’s reach. If your spell attack roll is successful, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the tree until the end of your next turn or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} if your spell attack roll was a critical success. The creature grabbed or restrained by the tree can attempt to [[/act escape]] and other creatures can attempt to free the grabbed or restrained creature by attempting a [[/act force-open]], using your spell DC for the DC of both checks. The tree uses and contributes to your multiple attack penalty.

If the tree is in soil and survives to the end of the spell's duration, it remains as an ordinary, non-magical tree and continues to grow and thrive. The GM might determine that the tree disappears immediately in certain inhospitable situations.

Heightened (+1) The tree’s height increases by 5 feet, its Hit Points increases by 10, and its AC increases by 3.

Curio Adept.name: Curio Adept
Curio Adept.description: The artifact grows with power, and so do you by extension. You gain the benefit associated with your selection of curio.

Impossible Mysteries.name: Impossible Mysteries
Impossible Mysteries.description: You have attained near-total enlightenment on your mystery, only to reveal more questions. When you make your daily preparations, you gain one cursebound oracle feat, even if its prerequisites require a different mystery. You can use that cursebound action until your next daily preparations.

Curse of Vengeful Darkness.name: Curse of Vengeful Darkness
Curse of Vengeful Darkness.description:
The darkness will always claim you, concealing you from the light and shrouding you in its enveloping embrace. Light seems not to live as brightly in your presence, and your shadow appears to be endlessly black even in the presence of light. When you have the cursebound condition and are in bright or dim light, your shadow lashes out at your body, taking @Damage[(@actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[bleed,persistent]|immutable]{persistent bleed damage equal to your cursebound value} or @Damage[(2 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[bleed,persistent]|immutable]{twice your cursebound value} if you are in bright light. When you are in darkness, you immediately stop taking persistent bleed damage from your curse, as your shadow instead latches on to the dark, giving you a –5-foot status penalty to all your Speeds, or a –10-foot status penalty if you are cursebound 2, or a –15-foot status penalty if you are cursebound 3 or greater. This status penalty to your Speeds also applies to your mount if you are mounted. Your shadow lies still again when you begin Refocusing to assuage your curse or if you fall unconscious, but your shadow resumes its behavior if your Refocus activity is interrupted or when you return to consciousness.

Foundry Note Use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.hqKL2q7hc3FvRlBY]{Effect: Curse of Vengeful Darkness (Mount Penalty)} to keep track of your mount's penalty to Speeds.

Curse of the Eternal Banquet.name: Curse of the Eternal Banquet
Curse of the Eternal Banquet.description:
You can get so swept up in celebration and joy that relaxing feels unappealing or even frightening. The colours you wear seem more vivid and bright to others, and delicious smells hang in the air around you, causing you to be more easily overwhelmed and influenced.

Cursebound 1 Consumption can lead to overwhelming the faculties. You gain poison weakness 2, and effects with the olfactory trait that target you trigger this weakness. Any immunity or resistance you have to such spells and effects is suppressed.

Cursebound 2 Greet the bounty of life with open arms. You don't treat anyone as an enemy until they take a hostile action against you (though they might still treat you as theirs). You can't target these creatures with hostile effects or include them in hostile area effects, unless the area would include at least one enemy.

Cursebound 3 Your weakness to poison damage is equal to 5 + your level.

Cursebound 4 The intoxication is overwhelming. You are offguard and you take a –2 status penalty against emotion effects.

Vision of the Long Odyssey.name: Vision of the Long Odyssey
Vision of the Long Odyssey.description:
Your vision showed you a distant place that you must reach. A cosmos oracle might see a castle in a vast redsanded desert, while a revelry oracle might see an inverted city on a cavern’s roof like grim stalactites.

Alternate Domain travel

Alternate Granted Spell 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ThE5zPYKF4weiljj]{Show the Way}

Granted Skill Acrobatics

Vision State On your first turn of an encounter and each time you use an action with the cursebound trait, you can Step as a free action. After the first turn in an encounter, if you end a turn without using move action or cursebound action that turn, you increase your cursebound value by 1 up to your maximum cursebound value.

Awakened State You can Step as a free action at the end of each of your turns. If your cursebound value is 3, you can Step up to 10 feet. If your cursebound value is 4, you also gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement}.

Snuff Out.name: Snuff Out
Snuff Out.description:
You call upon your inner darkness, and snuff out a pervading light. You can immediately attempt to @Check[counteract|statistic:spell] a light source within 30 feet, automatically succeeding if the light source is non-magical. You use your spell attack modifier for your counteract modifier and you gain a circumstance bonus to your check equal to your cursebound value.

You can choose to target a creature with the light trait or under a light effect instead of a light source, dealing @Damage[(@actor.level)d6[void]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|basic] save instead of the normal effects. Creatures targeted by this effect are temporarily immune for 1 minute. At 7th level, and every level thereafter, increase the void damage by 1d6.

Share Mystery.name: Share Mystery
Share Mystery.description: You can share your mystery with another, invoking your curse in exchange for power. During your daily preparations, choose a 1st-level oracle feat with the cursebound trait and a single ally with which you are currently traveling. The ally can use the granted cursebound action, but for all purposes it uses your cursebound value to determine the results and increases your cursebound condition as if you had used the action yourself. You must be willing for your ally to use this cursebound action and you must be able to use cursebound actions, or the action automatically fails.

Self-Stitching Wounds.name: Self-Stitching Wounds
Self-Stitching Wounds.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re conscious in an encounter.

Your body will not break as you wade into war. You gain fast healing equal to 4 x your cursebound value for as long you meet the requirements.

Inevitable Fate.name: Inevitable Fate
Inevitable Fate.description:
Trigger A creature would use an action or activity with the fortune or misfortune trait.

The inevitability of fate is inarguable, and when one attempts to sway its momentum, it can be easily returned to the course of time. If the triggering action or activity had the fortune trait, the creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC, or the triggering action gains the misfortune trait. If the triggering action or activity had the misfortune trait, it gains the fortune trait. As normal for effects that have both the fortune and misfortune traits, this cancels out the effect.

Harrowing Vision.name: Harrowing Vision
Harrowing Vision.description: You implant a harrowing vision in the mind of an enemy, leaving them distracted by the threat from your ally. Choose one enemy within 30 feet of you and then designate one ally, sending the enemy a vision of your ally causing them harm. As long as your ally is within reach of the enemy, the enemy is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn or the chosen ally damages the enemy. The target is then temporarily immune for 1 day.

Melt In Sunlight.name: Melt In Sunlight
Melt In Sunlight.description:
Domain sun (apocryphal)

Trigger You would take fire damage or be the target of an effect with the fire trait.

As fire scorches your body, you melt like wax left in the sun and shift forward. You become a puddle of amorphous liquid. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency modifier for unarmored defense. You gain resistance 8 to physical damage and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You can slip through tiny cracks. You can Dismiss the spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.5zI6wMVYamcEwbiU]{Effect: Melt in Sunlight}

Beast.name: Beast
Beast.description:
All things that hunger once came from beasts, and you are no different. Perhaps you had a mystical encounter at a holy shrine to a monster; perhaps you come from a people who revere lycanthropes as divine guardians, such as the Ulfen. Deities such as the Sarkorian Gods or monstrous ones such as Lamashtu or Mother Vulture are the ones most likely to gain your favor—or ire, should you resent your power.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.MPxbKoR54gkYkqLO]{Gouging Claw}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aEM2cttJ2eYcLssW]{Fleet Step}
  • 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wp09USMB3GIW1qbp]{Animal Form}
  • 5th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.YtesyvfAIwXOqISq]{Moon Frenzy}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.yCoJlIIopuCPi4Vw]{Body of the Beast}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.Ktv8fnq0j7x4VeFX]{Terrible Size}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.XGmpxQgckt6aRUxm]{Creature's Howl}

Related Domains change, destruction, moon, nature

Mystery Skill Intimidation

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.yiPogNDpDqAXlqTJ]{Hardened to Suffering}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.Dx34xI1uRFS6bJmS]{Curse of Monstrous Change}

Tenuous Threads.name: Tenuous Threads
Tenuous Threads.description:
The fate of another is a tenuous thread as pulled and twisted as the thread of a robe. Choose a number of creatures equal to 2 plus twice your cursebound value ([[/r 2 + 2 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value]]) within 30 feet of you. The creatures must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC. You can force the target to follow the direction of fate to approach you, run away (as if it had the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} condition), release what it's holding, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.HYNhdaPtF1QmQbR3]{Drop Prone}, or stand in place. Each target can be given a different direction and the target can choose not to follow the direction, in which case it takes a penalty depending on its save.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature must spend the first action on its next turn to follow the direction, or it suffers from diverging from fate. If the creature does not follow the direction, it must roll twice and take the worse result on its next attack roll or saving throw until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure The target must use all its actions on its next turn to follow the direction. If the creature does not follow the direction, it must roll twice and take the worse result on all of its attack rolls and saving throws it makes until the beginning of your next turn.

Oracle's Eyes.name: Oracle's Eyes
Oracle's Eyes.description: Your eyes are unusual, clouded by your mystery. Contrary to what others might believe, this clears your vision rather than obscuring it, and you can share this vision with others. Choose an effect with the illusion trait within 30 feet and attempt a counteract check against it as you lend others sight through your eyes. Alternatively, you can target a creature, and attempt to counteract one of the following conditions affecting that creature: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. You automatically succeed at a flat check due to invisibility when targeting a creature with this action. You use your spell attack roll modifier as your counteract modifier

Spread Disease.name: Spread Disease
Spread Disease.description:
Trigger You or a creature within 30 feet retch to remove the sickened condition.

The rot in your soul spreads as you cough and splutter. Choose another creature within 30 feet of the triggering creature. The target creature must attempt a @Check[fortitude|against:spell] save, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} on a failure, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure.

An Opening is Revealed.name: An Opening is Revealed
An Opening is Revealed.description: In the event your warning tips the scales, your ally responds in kind. If a creature in your aura of foresight fails an attack roll against an ally under the effects of Reveal the Mystery, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your ally until the end of your ally’s next turn.

Wielder of Mysteries.name: Wielder of Mysteries
Wielder of Mysteries.description: The artifact reaches its pinnacle of strength, deepening the power of your mystery. You gain the benefit associated with your selection of curio.

Weapon Trance (Team+).name: Weapon Trance (Team+)
Weapon Trance (Team+).description:
The serenity of violence fills your mind, giving you a heightened sense of knowing exactly where your weapons need to be. For the duration, your proficiency with the target weapons is equal to your proficiency with simple weapons, or to your proficiency with martial weapons if the target weapons are advanced. You automatically Sustain this spell as a free action the first time you attempt a Strike with the target weapon each round. If your cursebound value is 2, you gain a +1 status bonus to Strikes with the target weapons while the spell is active, or a +2 if you are cursebound value is 3 or greater.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.gE9AYanWhpYxENBk]{Spell Effect: Weapon Trance (Team+)}

Freezing Cold.name: Freezing Cold
Freezing Cold.description:
Area 2 or more contiguous squares, one of which must be adjacent to you

You cast out sheets of ice that stretch from your fingers. The frigid cold deals 1d6 cold damage, and the area becomes sheeted with a frigid flurry of difficult terrain.

1 The number of contiguous squares is 2, and the duration of the difficult terrain is 1 round.

2 (concentrate) The number of contiguous squares is 4, and the duration of the difficult terrain is 2 rounds.

3 (concentrate) YThe number of contiguous squares is 6, and the duration of the difficult terrain is 3 rounds.

The Question Remains.name: The Question Remains
The Question Remains.description:
Few understand the truth of your mystery as well as you do, to the extent that you have become an avatar of your mystic focus. When you would increase your cursebound condition, you can instead choose to increase your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed} value by 1. You can do this multiple times, but you do not die if your doomed value reduces your dying value to 0. If you gain the dying condition and your doomed value would normally kill you, you die instantly.

You remain at this doomed level until you spend 8 hours resting. When you die in this way, you immediately cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ion3VOiLan6ga3QC]{Conquering Soldiers} as manifestations of your mystery swarm the field. You stay alive until the Depart action of the spell is taken, and you leave with them to join your mystery as quintessence.

Speak in Tongues.name: Speak in Tongues
Speak in Tongues.description:
Your mystery grants a clarity that peers beyond language. When you increase the value of your cursebound condition, you can choose to learn a language temporarily for as long as you remain cursebound, but if you do the only languages you can speak while cursebound are languages you learned from this effect. You immediately lose these languages when you are no longer cursebound.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.t5NWv8KZClPjc0CE]{Effect: Speak in Tongues (Gain One Language)}

Astronomical Body.name: Astronomical Body
Astronomical Body.description:
Trigger You would take physical damage.

Your body becomes an absence of space, filled with visions of distant stars and worlds. You reduce the triggering damage by your level plus your cursebound value and you move [[/r 5 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value + 0 #feet]] feet away from the source of the triggering damage. This is forced movement.

Light.name: Light
Light.description:
Light is more than just the presence of flame; it is the dispeller of darkness, the revealer of truth, the carrier of lifestuff from the sun itself. You are filled with it like a little star, but the brighter it glows, the hotter it burns you. You could find your guiding lights via Sarenrae, Dajermube, or directly from Creation’s Forge itself. As long as your heart still beats, light will shine brightly from within you.

Granted Spells

  • cantrip: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WBmvzNDfpwka3qT4]{Light}
  • 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.m1vKX4xxWQJXfupu]{Glowing Trail}
  • 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HWrNMQENi9WSGbnF]{Wall of Radiance}
  • 4th: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ba1RyDpwq6tfW8VM]{Cloak of Light}

Revelation Spells

  • initial: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.WKktrOEvO2Hm9TF2]{Ray of Light}
  • advanced: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.pMw9249YMITuj2Y9]{Prism of Power}
  • greater: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.On86WPSyTK9jPkGS]{Divine Eclipse}

Related Domains healing, start, sun, truth

Mystery Skill Arcana

Oracle Feat @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.wZz04xU4HejpGTd4]{Astral Daydream}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.items.Item.D6A4gMTyEDDV1Fhq]{Curse of Impossible Radiance}

Comfort of Struggle.name: Comfort of Struggle
Comfort of Struggle.description:
Requirements You have taken damage since the beginning of your last turn.

Not only are you expecting pain, but you find comfort in it. You gain either a +1 status bonus to the next spell attack roll you attempt before the end of your turn or an enemy within 60 feet takes a –1 status penalty to the next saving throw they attempt against a spell you cast before the end of your turn. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Comfort of Struggle, the status bonus and penalty each increase to 2, and if you are cursebound 3, the status bonus and penalty each increase to 3.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.a1kOX7I3kKodRyqr]{Effect: Comfort of Struggle}

Rainbow Beam.name: Rainbow Beam
Rainbow Beam.description:
You harness all the brilliance of light and send a spectral blast towards an enemy. Make a @Check[spell|against:ac]{spell attack roll} against a creature within 30 feet of you. If your spell attack roll is successful, you deal @Damage[(@actor.level)d4[fire]] damage, or double this amount on a critical success. At 11th level, and every level thereafter, increase your beam’s damage by 1d4. Roll [[/r 1d8 #additional effect]] on the table below to determine the additional effect.

Roll

Colour

Effect

1

Red

You deal additional persistent fire damage equal to 2 plus twice your cursebound value. @Damage[(2 + 2 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[fire,persistent]]

2

Orange

You knock the target prone.

3

Yellow

The target is pushed [[/r 5 + 5 * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value]] feet.

4

The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} with a value equal to 1 plus your cursebound value.

5

The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus half your cursebound value. The creature can attempt a saving throw at the beginning of each of its turns, ending the paralyzed condition on a successful save.

6

Indigo

The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus half your cursebound value.

7
