The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus half your cursebound value.

8

Any

Choose a color of your choice and gain the corresponding effect.

Enchanting Rhapsody.name: Enchanting Rhapsody
Enchanting Rhapsody.description:
You use your music to influence your foes to do as you wish. Enemy creatures in the initial area or that end their turn in the area must make a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Success The target takes a –1 status penalty to their saves against mental effects until they leave the area and for 1 round after. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.xw2Z41yDSg7JW4hb]{Effect: Enchanting Rhapsody}

Failure As success, except the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} until they leave the area and for 1 round after and the status penalty increases to –2.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target must spend the first action on each of its turns to [[/act perform variant=dance]] by dancing to the music for as long as it is fascinated.

Escape Time's Shackles.name: Escape Time's Shackles
Escape Time's Shackles.description: You speed up your personal time bubble, allowing time to pass over you more quickly. Your body moves forward in time, causing 1 minute of time to effectively pass over for you. Any effects or conditions with a duration are immediately reduced by 1 minute. Roll saving throws, flat checks, damage, and any other rolls for those effects normally as if the time had passed. If your cursebound value is 2, you cause 1 hour of time to pass, and if your cursebound value is 3 you cause 1 day of time to pass. Escape Time's Shackles does not remove the cursebound condition or allow you to rest or make your daily preparations again.

Wishful Thinking.name: Wishful Thinking
Wishful Thinking.description:
You aid an ally by making the incredulous possible. Choose an ally within 30 feet of you and influence their mind to believe they are capable of the impossible, by granting them special powers of their dreams, choosing one of the listed effects. The effects of the spell last for the duration, but you must succeed at a @Check[deception|against:will|options:wishful-thinking-deception] check against the target’s Will DC at the end of each of your turns or the spell immediately ends. You can use your spell attack modifier instead of your modifier in Deception if it is higher.

  • The target gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws.

  • The target gains a +2 status bonus to skill checks for a specific skill of your choice.

  • The target gains a climb Speed of 30 feet and scent as an imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

  • The target gains a swim Speed of 30 feet with the ability to breath underwater.

Heightened (6th) The status bonuses increase by 1 and you can choose to give the target a fly Speed of 30 feet in addition to the other effects you could choose from.

Heightened (9th) You can choose two effects instead of 1.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.k7Hqre7oOIR6gInb]{Effect: Wishful Thinking}

Unknowable Icon.name: Unknowable Icon
Unknowable Icon.description:
Domain glyph (apocryphal)

You transcribe ancient and forgotten knowledge into a single rune that overwhelms and shatters the mind. You place a rune on a 5-foot square of a flat surface within your reach which remains dormant until a living creature other than you comes within 10 feet of it. After a creature comes within 10 feet, the rune becomes active after 1 round has passed and all creatures in a 10-foot emanation of the rune must attempt a basic Will Save or take 1d12 mental and 1d4 spirit damage. On a critical failure, the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 mental and 1d4 spirit.

Feel My Pain.name: Feel My Pain
Feel My Pain.description:
Trigger You take persistent damage.

You share your pain when it is dealt to you. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you. The creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC, taking the same persistent damage you take if it fails its save.

Well of Joy.name: Well of Joy
Well of Joy.description:
You fill an ally with hope for the future, granting them a renewed sense of vigor and joy. Choose a creature within 30 feet. The chosen creature gains 4 temporary Hit Points for 1 minute. If you’re cursebound 1 when you use Well of Joy, the creature gains 8 temporary Hit Points, if you’re cursebound 2 they gain 16 temporary Hit Points, and if you’re cursebound 3 they gain 24 temporary Hit Points. In addition, they are immune to fear effects while they have temporary Hit Points. If the creature has the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} condition it is suspended until the they no longer have temporary Hit Points, which returns with the same value as when it was suspended.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.2G2KHpPCP3VZggC9]{Effect: Well of Joy}

Curse of the Everpresent Sonata.name: Curse of the Everpresent Sonata
Curse of the Everpresent Sonata.description:
Try as you might, you cannot escape the song that follows you, and in moments of stress it grows louder and louder until it is all that you can hear. When you move, laugh or speak, the faint sound of musical instruments can sometimes be heard accompanying you, and everything you do has an almost rhythmic quality. When you have the cursebound condition, the music swells, and it becomes all that you can hear.

Cursebound 1 The song begins to play, drawing in other sounds like instruments in an orchestra. You gain sonic weakness 2, and hostile effects with the auditory trait that target you trigger this weakness.

Cursebound 2 The music is overwhelming your other senses. You take a –2 status penalty to Perception checks and to saves against auditory effects.

Cursebound 3 Your weakness to sonic damage is equal to 5 + your level.

Cursebound 4 The song is all-consuming. When you attempt to Cast a Spell that does not have the auditory or sonic traits, you must attempt a @Check[flat|dc:10] or you lose the spell.

Vision of the Weeping Heart.name: Vision of the Weeping Heart
Vision of the Weeping Heart.description:
Your vision shows you a tragedy you have yet to decipher, but may have the power to fix. An ice oracle might see a horned ape in a snowstorm and find themselves crying, and a forest oracle might be shown a sword being pulled out of the chest of a princess by an enormous will-o-wisp.

Alternate Domain repose

Alternate Granted Spell 1st: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.szIyEsvihc5e1w8n]{Soothe}

Granted Skill Diplomacy

Vision State You must heal the wounds of the broken, even if they are unwilling. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.tuZnRWHixLArvaIf]{Glimpse of Redemption} champion reaction except you reduce the resistance you grant allies by 2. If you go more than 1 round without using Glimpse of Redemption, you increase your cursebound value by 1 up to your maximum cursebound value. For the purposes of your Glimpse of Redemption your champion’s aura has a range of 5 feet plus an additional 5 feet x your cursebound value. At 6th level, your Glimpse of Redemption grants the normal amount of resistance.

Awakened State Instead of making an enemy who refuses redemption through Glimpse of Redemption enfeebled 2, you can choose to instead make the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for the same duration. If your cursebound value is 3, If the enemy refuses, it takes @Damage[(@actor.abilities.cha.mod)[spirit,persistent]] damage equal to your Charisma modifier. If your cursebound value is 4, you gain an additional reaction you can use only for Glimpse of Redemption

Foreseen Retaliation.name: Foreseen Retaliation
Foreseen Retaliation.description:
Your foresight not only protects your ally, but allows them to retaliate in kind. When you use Reveal the Mystery while benefiting from The Mystery Grows, you grant your ally the same status bonus to damage to its Strikes against the target of your Curio’s Foresight.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.z1p6jvxvqmks2kU9]{Effect: Foreseen Retaliation}

Curio's Form.name: Curio's Form
Curio's Form.description: When melded into your form, your curio remains available. When you enter a battle form, you retain the ability to use effects that depend on your curio, such as Curio’s Foresight. You gain the following effect while in battleforms depending on your curio.

Purge Sickness.name: Purge Sickness
Purge Sickness.description:
Requirements You have the sickened condition.

Your body is so accustomed to being ravaged by your curse that other such consequences are easily dismissed. You retch to reduce your sickened condition, gaining your cursebound value as a status bonus to your check to remove the condition. If you’re cursebound 2 when you use Purge Sickness, you treat your degree of success as one step better.

Tectonic Fracture.name: Tectonic Fracture
Tectonic Fracture.description:
With a long stare, you see where the world is weakest and shatter it. You stomp on the ground creating difficult terrain in a @Template[cone|distance:15] and creatures in the area must attempt a @Check[reflex|against:spell] save. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Tectonic Fracture, the area is a @Template[cone|distance:30] and if you are cursebound 3, it is instead a @Template[cone|distance:45].

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of your next turn.

Critical Failure The creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Atavistic Landslide.name: Atavistic Landslide
Atavistic Landslide.description: All things crumble with time, even ancient mountains, and you shall endure even this. At the end of each turn for 1 minute, you create a landslide of rubble and boulders that travels in a @Template[line|distance:35], except the line passes through you at the center point with an equal line on each side of you. The landslide deals @Damage[1d10[bludgeoning]|basic] damage to all creatures in the area with a @Check[reflex|basic|agaist:spell] save and creatures that critically fail their save are also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. You can't Dismiss this landslide, but you can suppress the effect for 1 round with a Sustain action. The landslide is suppressed if you fall unconscious. If you become cursebound 3 or 4 at any point during Atavistic Landslide's duration, the line increases to a @Template[line|distance:55] and the damage increases to @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]|basic].

Glimpse Future.name: Glimpse Future
Glimpse Future.description:
Though your eyes can't let you see everything that is around you, they show you images of what is to come. You [[/act recall-knowledge statistic=spell options=glimpse-future]] on a single creature within 30 feet of you using your spell attack modifier for your check against a standard DC for the creature's level, except you treat a critical failure as a failure, and the check loses the secret trait. If your check was successful, you can choose to give the target a –2 status penalty to the next attack roll or save before the beginning of your next turn. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune to Glimpse Future for 1 hour.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.13dAWN3gcT3uqOBw]{Effect: Glimpse Future}

Show to Remember.name: Show to Remember
Show to Remember.description:
You fill a creature's mind with an overwhelming din that disorients the target. Choose a creature within 30 feet of you, that creature must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute. The creature can spend a single action with the concentrate trait to attempt a new Will save against the effect.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for as long as they are stupefied.

Dance, Dance.name: Dance, Dance
Dance, Dance.description:
Your music floods the minds of two adjacent creatures, compelling them to move in time. Choose two creatures within 30 feet of you that are adjacent to each other. Both creatures must attempt a @Check[will|against:spell] save, but both creatures use the better result between them when determining the result of the effect. If you choose a willing ally as one of the targets, they can choose to get a result of a failure without rolling, but their movement triggers reactions to creatures other than the targets of this effect normally.

Critical Success The creatures do not move and a willing ally is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} from the shuffle.

Success Both creatures sway in a dance, moving 5 feet in a direction of your choice, remaining adjacent to one another. This is forced movement.

Failure As success, except both creatures move up to 10 feet, remaining adjacent to one another for the entirety of the movement.

Prism of Power.name: Prism of Power
Prism of Power.description:
You conjure an intangible magical prism that interacts with magic as if it were light. You create a prism that occupies a @Template[square|distance:5] within range. When you create the prism, select one of the following options.

  • Diffract Magic enters the prism and is split into a spectrum. If a line spell enters the area of the prism, the area changes from a line to a cone and its size is equal to half the remaining feet the line could travel before it entered the prism in the same direction the line could travel (minimum 5 feet).

  • Refract Magic entering the prism can change directions, even around corners. If a spell attack targets the prism or a line spell passes through its space, and doing so does not require all of the spell’s range, it can alter directions. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from the prism, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The spell can exceed its normal range as measured from you, as long as it's within its normal range from the prism.

  • Scatter Magic is dispersed and reflected all around the prism. You can target 2 creatures with a spell attack by targeting the prism, targeting up to 2 creatures within 5 feet of the prism. For the purposes of a spell attack roll, you roll your spell attack roll once and compare the result against the AC of both creatures.

Accursed Flame Form.name: Accursed Flame Form
Accursed Flame Form.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

You let sacred fire consume you, transforming you into a burning monster. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} heightened to the highest rank spell you can cast. You must choose an elemental form with the fire trait.

Special If you have access to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.bK4rp20XuJRWGsEv]{Elemental Shift} (Magic+), you can choose to gain the effects of elemental shift heightened to the highest rank spell you can cast and you must select the fire elemental aspect.

Reverse Movement.name: Reverse Movement
Reverse Movement.description:
You refract time in order to cover a great distance and then return to where you started. You mark your current location with a figment of your form and leave translucent images of yourself when you move for a number of rounds equal to 1 plus your cursebound value ([[/r (1+ @actor.conditions.cursebound.value )#rounds]]), tracing back to the space you first used this action. During this time, you gain access to the Reversal Move free action. After you use Reversal Move, you end this effect.

Reversal Move f (divine, oracle, teleportation)

Effect You swap places with your shadow in a burst of darkness. You create magical darkness that lasts until the end of your next turn in a 15-foot emanation around the position of your shadowy duplicate and yourself. You can choose to change positions with your shadow when you use this action, and if you do, the spell gains the teleportation trait.

Spirit Steps.name: Spirit Steps
Spirit Steps.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

Your body fades into ectoplasm, leaving you a translucent figure with a visible skeleton and chains tying you to the earth. You gain the incorporeal trait for 1 minute and a resistance to all damage (except spirit, vitality, or ghost touch) equal to twice your cursebound value, but you cannot pass through solid objects or walls. If your cursebound value is 3 when you use Spirit Steps, you can pass through solid objects, including walls while incorporeal. When inside an object, you can’t perceive, attack, or interact with anything outside the object, and if you start your turn in an object, you’re @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your turn. You and corporeal creatures can pass through on another, but neither of you can end your movement in the other’s space. If you are in the area of a solid object or wall when this effect ends, you take @Damage[(@actor.level)[spirit]]{spirit damage equal to your level} as you are shunted to the nearest space you could occupy.

Preparatory Cremation.name: Preparatory Cremation
Preparatory Cremation.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet of you takes fire damage.

You cause a burned creature to become ash-like, making them brittle and weak. The creature gains a weakness to physical damage equal to twice your cursebound value until the end of your next turn. Attacks that deal physical damage gain the death trait against the target while they have this weakness, their body turning into dust and ash if killed in this way.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Qkrxlll3LxBXBXup]{Effect: Preparatory Cremation}

Matchmaker.name: Matchmaker
Matchmaker.description:
Domain passion (apocryphal)

You gaze into the heart of the yearning, and find what will help their hearts settle. When you cast this spell, you Recall Knowledge with a special skill called Love Lore, in which you become trained for the duration. You find out if the target of your Recall Knowledge is the object of desire or yearns for another creature or object. You can also cast this spell to Make a [[/act request skill=love-lore]] to convince creatures to go on romantic excursions with others. If the target of the spell would not usually be willing to do so, the spell automatically fails.

Heightened (2nd) You become an expert in Love Lore for the duration.

Heightened (4th) You become a master in Love Lore for the duration.

Heightened (8th) You become legendary in Love Lore for the duration

Chosen Disciples.name: Chosen Disciples
Chosen Disciples.description: You have guided your followers to learn great secrets of your mystery. During your daily preparations, you can choose to grant one of your followers a 1st-rank divine spell in your oracle spell repertoire, gaining the ability to Cast the Spell once per day. At least 10th level, you can choose to grant one 2nd-rank spell in your oracle spell repertoire in addition to the 1st-rank divine spell, and if you are at least 12th level, you can choose to grant one 3rd-rank spell in your oracle spell repertoire in addition to the 1st-rank and 2nd-rank divine innate spell. If you have multiple followers, you can divide these spells among them.

Orb of Brilliance.name: Orb of Brilliance
Orb of Brilliance.description:
The enemy of the dark is the light, and it flees with great speed in its presence. You send out a burst of light in a @Template[burst|distance:20] within 500 feet. The burst generates bright light in the area and dim light 20 feet out from the area for up to 1 minute. Mist, fog, or other similar concealment does not grant the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition to creatures in the area unless the concealment would be the result of an effect that cannot be used to Hide (such as blur). The orb can be seen from great distances and creatures that end their turn within the area take a status penalty to Perception checks equal to your cursebound value.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.4O0gLYll9fdNQkCa]{Effect: Orb of Brilliance}

Unmitigated Gaze of the Curio.name: Unmitigated Gaze of the Curio
Unmitigated Gaze of the Curio.description: Your foresight has become so intense, the target of your focus cannot escape you. You gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight} on creatures that you have a +2 status bonus to AC and saves against from Curio’s Foresight.

Seismic Shift.name: Seismic Shift
Seismic Shift.description:
You bring the rocky mountain beneath your feet to propel you forward. You move up to 30 feet, the earth moving beneath your feet as it propels you to your destination, avoiding difficult terrain. You must end your movement in an unoccupied space where you have solid footing. Every square you pass through becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. This movement isn't a Stride, but you measure the distance in a similar way, and it still triggers reactions caused by movement. You can't transport anyone else with you.

Heightened (+1) Increase the distance you move by 5 feet.

Vision of the Glorious Victory.name: Vision of the Glorious Victory
Vision of the Glorious Victory.description:
In your vision, you were shown a climactic conflict that revolves around your mystery. A bones oracle might see a battle against a monster with two heads and three arms, while a song oracle might hear the anthem of a new nation in the face of legions of Hellknights.

Alternate Domain zeal

Alternate Granted Spell 2nd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.mrDi3v933gsmnw25]{Telekinetic Maneuver}

Granted Skill Athletics

Vision State You seek the visions answers in the triumph of battle. You gain a status bonus to Athletics checks equal to half your cursebound value (minimum 1). After the first turn in an encounter, if you end a turn without using an Athletics action or using a cursebound action that turn, you increase your cursebound value by 1 up to your maximum cursebound value.

Awakened State You gain the effects of an Athletics skill feat of your choice for which you meet the prerequisites for as long as you are awakened. If your cursebound value is 3, you gain your full cursebound value as a status bonus to Athletics checks. If your cursebound value is 4, you can choose to gain the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.wzctak6BxOW8xvFV]{Enlarge}.

Amplified Accompaniment.name: Amplified Accompaniment
Amplified Accompaniment.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

The music of your curse works to bolster other sounds instead of drowning them out, amplifying it and making creatures more sensitive to sound. For 1 minute, your music plays fervently in an aura in a 30-foot emanation bolstering other sounds and you must include yourself in the area and are included in the effects. Auditory and sonic effects originating within the area increase their range by 30 feet and linguistic effects no longer require that the target share a language while within the area. Creatures within the area gain a weakness to sonic damage equal to your cursebound value or increase their weakness to sonic damage by the same amount. Creatures with immunity to sonic damage are still immune.

Foundry Note Besides the granting of sonic weakness, the rest, you'll have to handle manually (including increasing existing weaknesses). If your cursebound value changes while this aura is active, reapply the aura.

Protection of the Mystery.name: Protection of the Mystery
Protection of the Mystery.description: Your mystery seeks to protect you, even when unprepared. Once per day you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{Contingency} as an divine innate spell heightened to a rank equal to half your level rounded up.

The More The Merrier.name: The More The Merrier
The More The Merrier.description:
What fun one can have when you are surrounded by revelers and debauchery. You create a crowd of illusory creatures of Medium size that fill all unoccupied spaces within the area. The area is difficult terrain and creatures cannot communicate or use auditory or linguistic actions on creatures more than 10 feet away from them while in the area.

In addition, you or your allies can spend a single action to Interact or Perform, causing the crowd in adjacent squares to become greater difficult terrain for 1 round. Creatures can attempt to disbelieve the crowd by spending a single action to Interact or Sense Motive on it. You and your allies ignore difficult and greater difficult terrain caused by the crowd.

Harness the Light.name: Harness the Light
Harness the Light.description:
You draw all the light into a tiny focal point, and disperse it in a small burst. Choose a magical source of light within 30 feet of you, and attempt to @Check[counteract|statistic:spell] it. If you created the magical light, you automatically succeed at your check to counteract. If you successfully counteract the magical light, all creatures in a @Template[emanation|distance:10] of the light source must succeed at a @Check[reflex|against:spell] save or they @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for a number of rounds equal to your cursebound value. If the creature critically failed its save against this effect, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round. If the target was a creature or shares its space with a creature, you must include the creature in the effect.

If you are cursebound and you target your curse’s light with this effect, you can produce the effect without attempting to counteract your magical light and you treat your degree of success on your save as one step better.

Carnivorous Vegetation.name: Carnivorous Vegetation
Carnivorous Vegetation.description:
You cause the plants around you to become carnivorous. You cause all plant-life in a @Template[emanation|distance:15] to become carnivorous, harming creatures that end their turn within the area and causing them to take @Damage[(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[acid],(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[piercing]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:spell] save. You and allies within the area get a degree of success one better than rolled on a saving throw.

Particularly large plants within the area when you first use the effect, such as trees, can choose to deal @Damage[(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[acid],(4 + floor(@actor.level / 2 - 6))d6[bludgeoning]]{bludgeoning damage} instead of piercing damage and each have their own emanation that produces the same effect. The emanation is a number of feet equal to the size of the plant, such as a 5-foot emanation for a bush that occupies a 5-foot square or a 15-foot emanation for a tree that occupies a 15-foot square. A creature in any of the areas attempts one basic Reflex save against the spell no matter how many overlapping vegetation areas it's caught in and the type of damage dealt is determined by the nearest to the vegetation (subject to GM discretion).

At 14th level, and every 2 levels thereafter, the acid damage and piercing damage each increase by 1d6.

Nourishing Rot.name: Nourishing Rot
Nourishing Rot.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet gains the sickened condition or becomes diseased.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

While sickness plagues your body, the illness of others cleanses you. You regain Hit Points equal to your level plus your cursebound value (@Damage[(@actor.level * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[healing]]).

Garden of Crystals.name: Garden of Crystals
Garden of Crystals.description:
Domain earth (apocryphal)

You cause crystals to grow from the ground around you. The area becomes difficult terrain, though you can ignore it. Select three @Template[burst|distance:5]s at least partially within the area; enormous clusters of crystals grow here, filled with magic energy. These crystalline structures are 10 feet high and occupy the area, moving any creatures in the area to the nearest adjacent space. When standing adjacent to one of these clusters, creatures' critical hits are empowered, dealing 1d10 force damage.

Heightened (+2) The force damage increases by 1d10.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.NsA3mbbBphp9kx77]{Effect: Garden of Crystals}

Hunter's Rush.name: Hunter's Rush
Hunter's Rush.description: You hone in on one enemy, becoming the target of your bestial animosity. Choose an enemy you can see. You Stride twice towards that enemy. If you end your movement within melee reach of the chosen enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Hunter's Rush, increase this to two extra dice, and if you are cursebound 3, increase it to three extra dice.

Curse of Outpouring Life (Team+).name: Curse of Outpouring Life (Team+)
Curse of Outpouring Life (Team+).description: Life energy flows outward from you and connects you to all living things, but you expend your vital essence to do so. Your presence comforts the ill and injured, causes scars to fade slightly, spurs new growth in plants, and otherwise infuses your surroundings with vitality. As your life force seeps outward, it becomes more difficult to keep your body functioning. Magical effects that restore Hit Points to you take a status penalty equal to half your level (minimum 1) times your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zXZjC8HLaRoLR17U]{Cursebound} value to the number of HP you recover.

Claimed by Ancestors.name: Claimed by Ancestors
Claimed by Ancestors.description:
Trigger You or an ally within 60 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed.

Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

Your ancestors surge around an unconscious body, dragging them back to their feet and fighting through them. The triggering creature does not die or gain the dying condition and regains @Damage[(@actor.level * @actor.conditions.cursebound.value)[healing]] Hit Points equal to your level x your cursebound condition value. However, the sudden surge from your ancestor is difficult to acclimate to, leaving the triggering creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} for 1 round unless it succeeds at a @Check[will|against:spell] save. If the triggering creature would have been killed, it treats its save against this confusion condition as one step worse.

Familiar Dark.name: Familiar Dark
Familiar Dark.description: The darkness is an old friend, familiar and comforting. You gain greater darkvision for 1 minute and create darkness in a @Template[emanation|distance:15]. If you are cursebound 2 when you use Familiar Dark, the aura is a @Template[emanation|distance:30] and if you are cursebound 3, it is instead a @Template[emanation|distance:120].

Storm Spell.name: Storm Spell
Storm Spell.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you're in an encounter.

You transform the components of a spell to become powerful blasts of storm magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the air, cold, electricity, or water traits that targets an area, you transform it into a storm spell. The area of the spell becomes difficult terrain and hazardous terrain for a number of rounds equal to your cursebound value. A creature that moves through the area takes damage equal to the spell's rank for every square of that area it moves through. This damage is electricity damage or bludgeoning damage, chosen when you Cast the Spell.

Astral Daydream.name: Astral Daydream
Astral Daydream.description: You leverage your connection to the spirit itself, your soul swiftly dancing between worlds, bringing back a gift from the beyond. You become stupefied 1 until the end of your next turn. While stupefied, you gain resistance equal to your cursebound value plus half your level to mental damage and become trained in a skill of your choice. If you were already trained in the chosen skill, you instead gain a +1 status bonus to your next check with the chosen skill for the duration, or a +2 status bonus if you are cursebound 2 when you use Astral Daydream.

Curse of Eternal Reverie.name: Curse of Eternal Reverie
Curse of Eternal Reverie.description: Your attachment to your whimsical imagination is both a blessing and a common plight. Your surface thoughts can sometimes flicker into images around you, and as your curse gets stronger, you become more and more distracted by the fancies nobody but you can make out. You have a status penalty to saves against mental and visual effects and to Perception checks equal to your cursebound modifier.

Divine Rampage.name: Divine Rampage
Divine Rampage.description:
Requirements Your cursebound value is 2 or greater and you’re in an encounter.

You become one with the beast, leaving you in an uncontrollable state and a destructive monster. The following effects apply until after you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points and then attempt a @Check[will|against:spell-dc] to end this destructive state. You can choose to forgo this Will save and continue your rampage. If you have not been targeted or included in the area of effect of a hostile action for 1 round, you can attempt a Will save to end this destructive state at the end of your turn.

  • You don’t treat anyone as your ally, except for flanking enemies (though they might still treat you as theirs).

  • You must use all your actions to Strike, cast offensive cantrips, use offensive cursebound actions, or to facilitate attacking, such as drawing a weapon, moving so a target is in reach, and so forth.

  • Your unarmed attacks gain the forceful trait.

  • When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points, you regain Hit Points equal to half your level plus your cursebound value.

Curio's Revelation.name: Curio's Revelation
Curio's Revelation.description: Your artifact possesses a unique method to reveal the purposes of the mystery. You can grant the following benefit instead of the normal effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.Js9vTrVqDJQeZ2uP]{Reveal the Mystery}.

Body of the Beast.name: Body of the Beast
Body of the Beast.description:
Animalistic power surges through you as you channel your divinity. You gain an unarmed attack in the brawling group as the beast within you emerges. The unarmed attack’s Strikes deal additional damage equal to your cursebound condition value. If your cursebound value is 2, you gain a +1 status bonus to Strikes with your unarmed attack while the spell is active, or a +2 if you are cursebound value is 3 or greater.

  • Jaws that deal 1d8 piercing damage

  • Claws that deal 1d4 slashing damage with the agile and finesse traits

  • Horns or antlers that deal 1d6 piercing damage with the shove trait

  • Tentacles or tail that deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage with the reach trait

Heightened (4th) You can select up to 2 unarmed attacks instead of 1 or increase the die size of one of your unarmed attacks by one step.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.alBwXHEEIgpe42Vt]{Effect: Body of the Beast}

Web of Darkness.name: Web of Darkness
Web of Darkness.description:
All the darkness in the area latches on like in webbed strands of shadow, hindering their movements. All enemy creatures in the area must attempt a Reflex save. Creatures can try to Escape the strands of darkness, and it or others can attempt to cut themselves free from the darkness by attacking the strands (the strands have AC [[/r 30+(@item.level - 6)*3]] and [[/r 30+(@item.level - 6)*5]] Hit Points). You can Dismiss the spell.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed.

Failure As success, except the creature has a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speed and it can’t move more than 30 feet away from the space it was in when you Cast the Spell.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-oracles-remastered.misc.Item.mOwOxk8Uwyz8hra5]{Effect: Web of Darkness}

Heightened (+1) The strands’ AC increases by 3, and their Hit Points increase by 5.

Hardened to Suffering.name: Hardened to Suffering
Hardened to Suffering.description: Your curse hardens you to outside pain. You gain your choice of a +1 item bonus to AC or increase the item bonus of any armor you are wearing by 1 until the end of your next turn. While you are benefiting from this bonus to AC, you gain resistance to physical damage equal to 2 plus twice your cursebound value.

Vision of the Unraveling Secret.name: Vision of the Unraveling Secret
Vision of the Unraveling Secret.description:
Your vision showed you something of dire importance that you cannot yet understand– but unraveling its meaning will help you change the fate of the world. A lore oracle might see an elephant opening a door into an impossible library, while a beast oracle might be shown an eggshell twice the size of a man in a plane of fractal glass.

Alternate Domain knowledge

Alternate Granted Spell 3rd: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ZYoC630tNGutgbE0]{Hypercognition}

Granted Skill one skill with the Recall Knowledge action

Vision State Understanding will empower you. On your first turn of an encounter and each time you use an action with the cursebound trait, you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} as a free action, but if you Recall Knowledge it must be on a creature, hazard, or similar subject in the current encounter. You gain a status bonus to your Recall Knowledge and Seek checks equal to your cursebound value. After the first turn in an encounter, if you end a turn without using Recall Knowledge, Seek, or a cursebound action that turn, you increase your cursebound value by 1 up to your maximum cursebound value.

Awakened State You can either Recall Knowledge or Seek as a free action at the end of each of your turns, and you can Recall Knowledge on the same subject more than once even if you failed your Recall Knowledge, so long as the subject is in the current encounter. If your cursebound value is 3, you gain the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}. If your cursebound value is 4, you also gain the effects of a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.uqlxMQQeSGWEVjki]{Truesight}.
